->ZAHEL<-
->**On the rising of the fourth triplicity.**<-

[[notes: In astrology, a "triplicity" is a group of three zodiac signs belonging to the same element. The "fourth triplicity" refers to the Water signs: Cancer, Scorpio, and Pisces.]]

If indeed the ascendant [[notes: The sign rising on the eastern horizon at a specific moment]] should be Cancer, Scorpio, or Pisces, because these are aquatic signs, it is good during their rising to do all things that pertain to water—such as casting nets into the water, practicing every kind of fishing, bathing, constructing baths, building enclosures for a mill, directing the course of water, and many other things that cannot be enumerated.

->### On the hour of Saturn, and the sign, and its ascendant.<-

This must be observed all the more diligently: if it should be the hour of Saturn, and a sign of Saturn [[notes: Capricorn or Aquarius]] is ascending, it is a marvelous time to do all those things that were mentioned regarding the hours of Saturn. Understand the same for all other hours and signs; if you can, match the hours with the signs, for this is best. What we have said regarding Saturn, understand thus for all the other planets.

# ->ZAHEL ON ELECTIONS<-

## ->B O O K.<-

[[insert: Historiated initial O depicting a figure, possibly an astronomer or scholar, within a circular frame.]] **A**ll have agreed that "elections" [[notes: The practice of picking a specific time to start an activity to ensure success]] are weak, except in the case of kings. Even if their chosen times are weak, their "roots"—that is, their nativities [[notes: The birth chart or *radix*]]—strengthen every planet that is weak during a journey. For women, however, and merchants, and those who follow them, do not choose anything for them except based upon their nativities, the revolutions of their years, and the nativities of their children. For those whose birth details are unknown, let "interrogations" [[notes: Also known as Horary astrology: casting a chart for the moment a question is asked]] be accepted for them. Let the outcome of their business be known from these, and afterwards let a time be chosen for them according to this; for when someone asks a question about themselves, they have already arrived at good or evil from their own nativity. Because he has asked you, indicate the answer to him according to his interrogation.

Be careful, therefore, with elections of this kind. For how can you choose a time for one whose "root" [[notes: The underlying potential in their birth chart]] is distracted? This is especially true since the birth chart is the first beginning and the ancient root in which trust is placed. Take care, therefore, not to choose a time for someone whose root of nativity or interrogation signifies something horrible; for when that time arrives, even if you place all the "fortunes" [[notes: Beneficial planets like Jupiter and Venus]] in the "angles" [[notes: The most powerful houses in a chart]] and cause all the "evils" [[notes: Malefic planets like Mars and Saturn]] to fall away from him, it will profit him nothing. Every planet that does not agree with the Lord of his Ascendant [[notes: The planet that rules the sign rising at the person's birth]] will not benefit that man at all, especially those who are of useful or mediocre status. This is because you do not know whether the ascendant or the star you choose might be an enemy to him in his "root," or if there was some evil in that same ascending sign you chose for him.

Indeed, we wonder at nothing in those who sail the sea, or those who travel abroad at the same hour with the same intention. Yet some of them suffer shipwreck, while others escape; some of them find wealth, while others find nothing. The fate of some is not made like the fate of others. I have already proven this many times in a comparison of certain people who departed from a place at the same hour and arrived at another region at the same hour: some of them returned more quickly with excellent wealth, some were delayed there, and some perished before they could return to their homes. This happened to them because of their nativities and because of the changes occurring in those specific years. We even see some people rejoicing and drinking on an "evil" day—that is, a day of many obstacles—while a quarrel gathers and falls upon others on a "good" and praiseworthy day. You might perhaps see a significator [[notes: A planet representing the person or the goal]] joined to an evil planet by a "fourth aspect" [[notes: A square aspect, usually considered stressful]] or opposition, or in the same sign, yet the person finds good fortune in it. This occurs only because the "evils" perhaps agreed with him more, as they were the Lords of his first Ascendant, or the Lords of his "division," or the Lords of the Ascendant of his yearly revolution.

When, however, you choose a time based on the Ascendant of an interrogation or a nativity which you know, or upon the Lord of the sign of the year's "profection" [[notes: A technique of advancing the chart by one sign per year]], your election will be more worthy, because you will know which of the stars is suitable for him and what his disposition is. Be careful, therefore, in this chapter, and let your work be similar to your election. Know that the Almighty and Most High created every creature—namely the world and whatever is in it—from the four natures (that is, from the four elements). He placed the earth and everything upon it, both the rational and irrational, the mobile and immobile, within the "circle" [[notes: The celestial sphere or zodiac]]. Between these and the circle He placed a "subtle thing" which the wise know—like that subtle occasion He placed between the lodestone and iron, or that which is between a father and son, or between the eater and the food. Know these things and understand them. From the harmony, therefore, which exists between both substances—namely the superior...

[[meta: This page continues a discussion on the natures of planets (benefics and malefics) before transitioning into a detailed guide on how the three qualities of Zodiac signs—Movable (Cardinal), Fixed, and Common (Mutable)—affect the success of various daily activities. This practice is known as "Electional Astrology," or choosing the most auspicious moment to begin a task.]]

### ->ON ELECTIONS<- [[page number: 115]]

...although of a lower [order], they temper matters; yet by adversity they destroy, even if they are equal to the fortunes [[notes: "Fortunes" or *fortunae* refers to beneficial planets like Jupiter and Venus]]. That is, they are of a temperate nature, while the "evils" [[notes: *mali*, or malefic planets like Saturn and Mars]] are of a harmful nature. Therefore, they desire to hinder, and even if they receive [an influence], their substance, heat, and diversity will not be entirely lacking. They are like thieves and the citizens of evil among men; from them comes diversity, discord, change, and the confusion of things. Understand all of this.

### *The Ascendant, and what pertains to it regarding elections in the science of the natures of the signs, of which the first are the movable.*

Know that movable [[notes: These are now commonly called "Cardinal" signs: Aries, Cancer, Libra, and Capricorn.]] signs signify the swiftness of things and indicate that nothing in them shall be durable, [[margin: Movable signs.]] nor will their duration be prolonged. However, it is good to sow, buy, sell, and confirm a wife [[notes: Meaning to finalize a marriage or betrothal contract]] under them; all these things profit under them. A sick person will be quickly cured, a dispute will not be prolonged, and a fugitive will return quickly. Travel is also useful under them. But if someone promises something under these signs, he will not fulfill the promise; speech, dreams, and rumors will be false. No doctor should practice under them, nor should any planting be done, nor should a foundation be laid, for it is bad; whatever you begin under them for which you desire stability will not be stable. But any unstable work or haste you wish to achieve, begin it under them. Aries and Cancer are swifter than the other movables, for they have more "crookedness" [[notes: *tortuositas*, likely referring to the rapid change of the sun's path at the equinox/solstice]] and more mobility; Libra and Capricorn, however, are stronger and more temperate.

Furthermore, fixed signs are suitable for every work where stability and the prolongation [[margin: Fixed.]] of time is sought, and for whatever the author wants to be durable and good. It is useful to build and celebrate weddings under them, provided the betrothal took place in movable signs. If a woman is sent away by her husband under these signs, she will not return to him. In beginnings and initiations, there is no confidence in them unless the testimonies of the "fortunes" are multiplied. Whoever is bound under them will have his imprisonment prolonged, and whoever is angered under them cannot be quickly appeased. Contracts and wages are useful under them; it will be good to build and to lay a foundation. Scorpio is the lightest of all the fixed signs, Leo is the most fixed, Aquarius is the slowest and worst, while Taurus is the most level.

Common signs [[notes: Now called "Mutable" signs: Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, and Pisces.]] are useful in participation and [[margin: Common.]] brotherhood. Whatever is performed under them will often be repeated. Buying and celebrating weddings under them will be neither useful nor profitable; there will be trickery and deception in them. Whoever is accused of something under them escapes and is healed of the charge. Whoever is incarcerated under them is not held except in fear, specifically because of the smallness of his appearance and his exit [[notes: Implying he might be released or moved quickly due to lack of evidence or presence]]; he who leaves prison will return to his place. If a fugitive is captured under them, he will return to his flight a second time. Whoever goes before a judge under them will find neither sentence nor judgment confirmed for him. No one should go upon a ship under them, for he who goes will be moved from that ship to another. If something is promised to someone under these signs, it is dissolved, and nothing of it is completed. A sick person is healed under them, then suffers a relapse. Therefore, everything that happens to a man, whether good or evil, is doubled upon him in these signs. If someone dies under them, another will die in that place very soon after. Changing and washing the head and beard, the refining of gold and silver, and sending boys to their letters [[notes: Meaning to start school or begin learning to read/write]] are all appropriate under these signs.

If you wish to begin any of the things I have told you, then place the Moon in the Ascendant [[notes: The sign rising on the eastern horizon]] of those houses suitable to what you desire, and join the Moon with "fortunes" that receive her in that sign. The signs of the day are stronger in comparison to the day; therefore, set a diurnal Ascendant.

Aerial signs are suitable for hunting on land and sea. Royal signs are suitable for kings. Signs that "have voices" [[notes: *Signa vocalia*—traditionally Gemini, Virgo, Libra, and sometimes others—believed to favor speech and song]] are suitable for those who play the flute with *crudo* and the voice of *alhool* [[notes: *Alhool* is likely a Latinization of the Arabic *al-ghul* or a specific musical term used in medieval texts to describe a certain vocal quality or range]] and songs. Fiery signs are suitable for everything done with fire. Signs of equality [[notes: The Equinoxes]], in which night and day are equal, are suitable for truth and truth-telling, and for those who work with scales. Mutable signs—those in which the day and night begin to change [[notes: The Solstices]]—are suitable for change and for him who wishes to move from one thing to another. Consider for every work you wish to begin what the nature of that sign is from the spheres, and join the Moon and the Lord of the Ascendant with that substance, and the root of that nature, and the power with that hour—that is, the hour of the beginning.

If you desire something concerning lords, princes, great men, city prefects, notable people, battles, and illnesses, it belongs to you through the Sun. What concerns sublime things belongs to you through Jupiter. Farmers and the lowest people belong to you through Saturn. Leaders and lords of battles belong to you through Mars. What concerns women belongs to you through Venus. Purchases, sales, disputes, written matters, and business belong to Mercury. In the mixing of reigns, matters concerning women and their inquiries belong to the Moon.

The text transitions from general principles to specific "Elections"—the practice of choosing the most auspicious moment to begin a task.]]

[[page number: 114]]

-># **ZAHEL**<-

->### *Election concerning the beginning of any work, and concerning the ten*<-
->### *impediments of the Moon*<-

When, therefore, you wish to begin any work, strengthen [[notes: "Strengthen" in astrology means ensuring a planet is in a favorable sign or house]] the Ascendant [[notes: The zodiac sign rising on the eastern horizon at the moment of beginning]] and its lord, as well as the Moon and the lord of that specific matter. Beware of the impediments of the Moon, as Dorotheus [[notes: Dorotheus of Sidon, a 1st-century Greek astrologer whose poems on electional astrology were highly influential]] and other wise men have said regarding the beginning of works; and there are ten ways this happens. The first way is when she is "combust" [[notes: "Combust" means a planet is so close to the Sun that its power is "burned up" or hidden]] within 12 degrees before the Sun, and similarly after him, although it is less severe after him. The second is when she is in the degree of her descension [[notes: Also called her "fall," the sign where her influence is weakest (Scorpio)]]. The third is when she is in opposition to the Sun [[notes: A Full Moon]]. The fourth is when she is joined with the malefics [[notes: Usually Mars and Saturn, planets associated with challenge]], or in the light of their square aspect or opposition. The fifth is when she is at the Head or Tail [[notes: The Lunar Nodes, where the Moon's path crosses the Sun's path, associated with eclipses]], from the exact degree to 12 degrees away, which is the limit of an eclipse. The sixth is when she is in the final degrees of the signs, which are the "terms" of the malefics. The seventh is when she is falling from the "angles" [[notes: The 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th houses of a chart, which are the strongest positions]], or in the *Via Combusta* [[notes: The "Burned Path," a specific section of the zodiac (late Libra to early Scorpio) traditionally considered unlucky]], and this is the worst of the ten impediments of the Moon, especially if the beginning concerns a marriage, or anything regarding the affairs of women, or buying, selling, or travel. The eighth is when she is in the seventh sign from her own house—that is, in Gemini [[notes: The Moon's "house" is Cancer; Gemini is actually the 12th sign from Cancer, while Capricorn is the 7th. The author may be following a specific tradition or there is a minor transcription error in the original Latin "Geminis"]]—with a malefic, or when she is in opposition to her house, or not "beholding" [[notes: Forming a geometric aspect with]] it. The ninth is when the Moon is slower in her course, which the wise call the "likeness of the course of Saturn," when her daily movement is less than 12 degrees; even if it were less by one minute, this is when her daily course is less than her "mean" [[notes: average]] daily course which is written in the "canon"—that is, in that book of movements [[notes: An astronomical table or ephemeris]]. The tenth, which Messahallach [[notes: Masha'allah ibn Athari, a Persian Jewish astrologer (c. 740–815 AD)]] and the wise men of our time have spoken of, is when the Moon is "void of course" [[notes: When the Moon makes no further aspects to other planets before leaving her current sign]]. Strengthen the Moon as much as you can, and do not place her in the Ascendant for anyone, because this is to be feared on account of what might happen to the body’s lord in the form of infirmities, unless she is the lord of the Ascendant or a benefic planet is beholding the degree of the Ascendant. For a planet that does not behold its own house is like a man absent from his home, who cannot repel anything from it or protect it; but when a planet beholds its own house, it is like the master of the house who guards it—everyone inside fears him, and those outside fear to approach it. And if the lord of the Ascendant is a malefic, make it behold the Ascendant from a trine or sextile aspect [[notes: Favorable 120-degree or 60-degree angles]], and beware of placing the Moon in the angles when she is impeded. Instead, place the "fortunes" [[notes: The benefic planets, Jupiter and Venus]] in the angles of the Ascendant, or the Moon, when there are two fortunes beholding her from an angle and you have placed her in the angles of the Ascendant. Do not let the "Part of Fortune" [[notes: A calculated mathematical point in a chart representing prosperity]] fall away from the aspect of the Moon or its conjunction in any beginnings or questions; do not worry if the Part itself is "falling" from the Ascendant, provided the Part beholds both the Ascendant and the Moon. Strive to place the lord of the Ascendant with the Part, as this is more useful and brings greater profit. Never place the Moon in the second, sixth, eighth, or twelfth house from the Part, as this is terrible. Always establish the Ascendant and the Moon in all beginnings in signs of "direct ascension" [[notes: Signs that take longer to rise over the horizon (in the Northern Hemisphere: Cancer through Sagittarius), associated with ease and progress]], because this signifies lightness and success; do not place them in signs of "tortuous ascension" [[notes: Signs that rise quickly (Capricorn through Gemini), associated with complication and delay]], for that signifies entanglement and slowness. The Ascendant and the fourth house from it signify what will happen to that election. Look, therefore, to the fortunes and the malefics and their locations, whether they are strong or weak, and speak upon the beginning of that matter and its end based on that strength and weakness. And Dorotheus said: when you see the Moon is impeded, and a matter is at hand that absolutely must be done and cannot be deferred, do not give the Moon a place in the Ascendant; make her fall away from the Ascendant, and place a fortune in the Ascendant, and strengthen the Ascendant and its lord.

->### *The second sign or second house with its elections, and first*<-
->### *concerning the receiving and lending of money.*<-

**W**hen you wish to choose an hour for the receiving and lending of money, let the Moon be in Leo, or in Pisces, or in Scorpio, or Sagittarius, or in Aquarius. Let her be waning in light, and let both fortunes be decreasing and beholding the Moon or the Ascendant. Let Mercury be "clean" from Mars [[notes: Meaning Mercury should not be in a difficult aspect with Mars]], and the Moon be with Jupiter or Mercury. Beware lest the Moon be impeded by any of the malefics, and let not Mercury be joined to them or in a square aspect with them; nor should the fortunes be "falling," for if the Moon is with Mars, the matter will fall into labor, anxiety, negotiation, and hardship. And if she is impeded by Saturn, it will fall into prolongation and delay, and the money will only be released after distress and exhaustion. If, however, you wish to hide the lending itself, [[margin: so that no one]]

-> **ON ELECTIONS** <-

[[notes: An "Election" is the process of choosing a specific moment in time when the alignment of the stars is most favorable for a planned action, such as starting a business or getting married.]]

...so that no one can perceive it, let the Moon—when you receive or seek this—be "under the sun’s rays." [[notes: "Under the rays" refers to a planet being so close to the Sun (within 15 degrees) that it becomes invisible to the naked eye, symbolizing secrecy.]] If you go toward a conjunction of the "fortunes" [[notes: The "fortunes" or benefics are Jupiter and Venus, planets believed to bring luck.]] after the Moon's separation from the Sun, the matter will be entirely easier and will not be made public. However, if the Moon, upon its exit, is moving from "combustion" [[notes: "Combustion" is the most intense state of being near the Sun (within 8.5 degrees), usually considered weakening or "burning" the planet's power.]] toward a conjunction with Mars, the matter will be made public, and you will fall into the mouths of men—especially those you do not wish to know of it. And take care that the Moon is not in the "circle of signs" [[notes: the ecliptic]] without latitude—that is, in the Head or Tail [[notes: The North and South Nodes of the Moon, where eclipses occur]], or in the "combust way" [[notes: The *Via Combusta*, a traditionally unlucky stretch of the zodiac spanning the end of Libra and the beginning of Scorpio]], because this is a terrible omen. Dorotheus [[notes: Dorotheus of Sidon, a highly influential 1st-century Greek astrologer often cited in medieval and Renaissance texts]] said: Do not accept a loan, nor lend anything to anyone, while the Moon is in the first degree of Leo, Gemini, or Sagittarius, or if these signs are ascending, because this is hateful to the act of lending itself. Know this well.

-> *Election for a partnership with someone regarding property or any work.* <-

If you wish to enter into a partnership with someone concerning property or labor, it is best for the Moon to be "clean" from the "malics" [[notes: The "malics" or malefics are Mars and Saturn, planets associated with challenge or misfortune]] and joined to the fortunes. Let it be in "common signs" [[notes: Also known as "mutable" signs (Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Pisces), which represent flexibility and growth]] so that their profit may be multiplied. Alternatively, let the Moon be in Leo or Taurus. It is a dreadful thing for partners if the Moon is in the "lower signs," and the worst of all is Libra, because the "combust way" is located there; likewise, Aquarius is to be dreaded. Let the Moon be received by a "trine" or "sextile" aspect [[notes: Harmonious angles of 120 and 60 degrees respectively]] so that their eventual separation may be on good terms. If they are in a "quartile" (square) aspect or opposition, there will be "talk" between them—meaning a quarrel—at the time of separation. An aspect of "dilection" [[notes: a favorable or "loving" aspect]] signifies the goodness or honesty of their parting, as well as their mutual loyalty and benevolence. Beware of the presence of the "malics" in the "angles" [[notes: The 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th houses, the most powerful positions in a chart]], for the "Ascendant" [[notes: the 1st house]] represents the one beginning the partnership (or the elder person). The "Seventh House" represents the other partner; the "Tenth House" signifies what will happen between them and whether the profit will be great or small; and from the "Fourth House," the final outcome of their business is known. Take care that the "Lord of the Ascendant" [[notes: the planet ruling the sign on the eastern horizon]] does not fail to "look at" [[notes: form a geometric aspect with]] the Ascendant, and that the Lord of the Moon’s house does not fail to look at the Moon. If this happens, each will deceive his partner, and their affairs will worsen upon separation.

-> *Election for sending property to gain profit from it.* <-

If you wish to send out goods or capital seeking a profit, harmonize the Moon and Mercury, as well as the "Lord of the house of property" and the Lord of the degree of the "house of trust." [[notes: Likely referring to the 11th house of hopes and friends, or the 2nd house of wealth.]] Let the Moon be joined to Mercury, and make Mars "fall away" from both as much as you can. Refine Mercury also, and purge it of "vices" [[notes: Astrological "vices" include being retrograde or afflicted by bad planets]]. If Mercury is "retrograde" [[notes: appearing to move backward in the sky, often associated with delays or errors]], then harmonize the Moon and the degree of the Lord of the house of trust, and their Lords, and make Mercury fall away from the light of Mars; but do not make it fall away from the aspect of Venus or from the Lord of the Eleventh House. Let your trust always be in the direction of the property and the seeking of profit through Mercury, the Moon, the degree of the house of trust, and their Lords; and make Mars and its light fall away from them.

-> *Election for buying and selling.* <-

If you wish to choose an hour for a purchase, harmonize the "Part of Fortune," [[notes: A specific mathematical point in a chart representing prosperity]] and let it be in the "houses of Jupiter" [[notes: Sagittarius or Pisces]] joined to the fortunes, for this is better for the buyer than for the seller. When the Moon is in "signs of direct ascension" [[notes: Signs that take longer to rise over the horizon, thought to be more favorable for long-term gain]], increased in light and number, and joined to the fortunes, whatever the owner buys in that hour, he will lose nothing in it; this is better for the buyer than the seller. Also, let Mars fall away from the Moon and Mercury, because Mars hinders buying and selling, being the planet that signifies labor and contention. Similarly, make the "Tail" [[notes: the South Node]] fall away from the Moon specifically, as it is ranked below Mars in its ill effects. If you wish to sell, place the Moon in its "Exaltation" [[notes: a sign where a planet’s power is most highly expressed, e.g., Taurus for the Moon]] or its "Triplicity," separated from the fortunes and looking at the malics, but not joined to them. [[notes: This suggests that a "bad" alignment for the chart might actually favor a seller looking to unload goods at a high price to a buyer's disadvantage.]]

-> *Election in the works of alchemy.* <-

If you wish to practice alchemy, or any work you wish to repeat, let it be done when the Moon is in "common signs," clean from the malics; let the Ascendant be the same, and harmonize them. If your work involves gold, strengthen the Sun, and harmonize it at the start of the work.

-># **Z A H E L**<-

->### ***The fourth sign, or the fourth house, and whatever pertains to it regarding elections; and first, for the building of a house.***<-

**W**hen you wish to choose a time to build a house, arrange the Moon and its lord [[notes: The "lord" is the planet that rules the sign the Moon is currently occupying]], the degree of the Ascendant [[notes: The zodiac sign rising on the eastern horizon at the moment of the start]] and its lord, as well as the Part of Fortune and Mercury. Make Mars fall away from these significators which I have named for you, and never give him a share in any part of the building of houses. If it cannot be helped that he has a share, place Venus strongly in her own place, but do not give her more strength than Mars. Join her to him by a trine or sextile aspect [[notes: These are "harmonious" angles of 120 and 60 degrees]], because Mars does not hinder the work of Venus due to the great friendship he has toward her. Furthermore, make Saturn fall away from Venus as much as you are able, because of his enmity with both Mars and the Moon when they regard each other with "affection" [[notes: *Dilectio* here refers to a favorable aspect]]. Let the Moon be increasing in light and in number [[notes: Meaning the Moon is waxing and increasing its daily speed]], and joined to Jupiter by a fourth aspect [[notes: A square aspect of 90 degrees]], because this is better than an opposition, and this signifies the beauty of the building and its perfection. Beware lest the Moon be with Saturn or the Tail [[notes: *Cauda Draconis*, or the South Node of the Moon, considered a point of depletion and bad luck]], or that Saturn be in the Ascendant or the fourth house, because this signifies slowness and hardship in the work; the building may not be raised, or if it is raised and inhabited, the inhabitants will not cease to suffer fears, infirmities, labors, and tribulations unto death. The building may be cracked and perhaps even fall. If Mars should look upon it, and the Ascendant is in the circle of the apogee or a short ascension [[notes: Technical terms regarding the speed and path of the sign]], there is fear of fire or collapse. Let the Moon then be increased in light, for then it will be useful to its master. Let the lord of the house of the Moon be looking upon it. Similarly, let the lord of the Ascendant be looking upon the Ascendant, and let these be clean from the "malefics" [[notes: The planets Saturn and Mars]], because if they do not look upon these points, the master of the house will not remain in it.

---

->### *Election for destroying a house.*<-

And when you wish to demolish a house, let it be when the Moon is descending in its circle [[notes: Moving toward its southern limit or decreasing in speed]], and let it be separated from the malefics and joined to the "fortunes" [[notes: The benefic planets Jupiter and Venus]]. Let the fortune itself be oriental [[notes: Rising before the Sun]], or the Ascendant be direct, or let the Moon be joined to the lord of its own house out of "affection"—that is, by a trine or sextile aspect—so that its destruction may be easier. Truly, in a fourth aspect or an opposition, the destruction will be more difficult for them.

---

->### *Election for buying land, or leasing it, so that you may receive income from it.*<-

And if you wish to buy lands and enter into them with someone, or you wish to hold land to receive income from someone, let Saturn be in his exaltation [[notes: For Saturn, this is the sign of Libra]], or in his triplicity or term [[notes: Essential dignities or specific segments of the zodiac where a planet is "at home"]]. Let Jupiter be in aspect to him from an angle or a trine aspect, and make Mars fall away from them. Let the Moon be at the beginning of the month, looking upon Saturn with affection, increased in number, and in the aspect of Jupiter; for this signifies the population of that land and its income. But if you cannot have the aspect of Jupiter with Saturn, place Venus in the place of Jupiter, and make the water signs fortunate [[notes: Cancer, Scorpio, and Pisces]], because when you make them fortunate with the "fortunes," they will be better than the air signs. Let the Moon be in its exaltation [[notes: Taurus]], or in the Midheaven [[notes: The highest point of the chart]], and the lord of the Ascendant looking upon it. Let both the Moon and the Ascendant be clean from malefics and from vices [[notes: "Vices" refers to debilitating astronomical conditions like being "combust" or burnt by the Sun's proximity]].

---

->### *Election for leading a spring, or digging a well.*<-

And when you wish to divert a river, or dig a well or channels, let it be when Saturn is oriental, and the Moon is under the earth in the third or fifth house, free from malefics, fortunate, and "received" [[notes: Reception occurs when a planet is in a sign ruled by the planet it is aspecting]]. Beware lest any of the malefics be in the Midheaven, because it is then to be feared that the well or the channel may collapse, or the river may overflow. Let Saturn be in the eleventh house from the Ascendant, and let the Moon be joined to a "fortune" in a fixed sign [[notes: Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, or Aquarius, which represent stability]]. The Ascendant in the circle is better for the fortunes and Jupiter. If you cannot do this, place the fortunes in the Midheaven, for in this way the river is more durable and the channel or well more stable.

---

->### *Election for planting trees.*<-

And if you wish to plant palms, fig trees, and other trees, let it be when the Moon is in a fixed sign, and the lord of its house looks upon it from the water signs. Let the Ascendant be a fixed or common sign [[notes: Common or "mutable" signs are Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, and Pisces]], and the lord of the Ascendant be ascending and oriental. For if it is ascending but not oriental, they will grow more quickly, but they will cause a delay in fruiting. And if it is oriental, descending... ...descending, they will be born late, and will fruit quickly: and if it be occidental [[notes: "Occidental" refers to a planet that sets after the Sun]] and descending, both their birth and their fruiting will be delayed; and let the Lord of the Ascendant and the Lord of the Moon's house be aspecting [[notes: An "aspect" is a specific geometric angle between planets, believed to transmit their influence]] them, and let them be free from the malefics [[notes: "Malefics" are traditionally the planets Mars and Saturn, associated with hardship]] and from combustion [[notes: A planet is "combust" when it is too close to the Sun, which was thought to weaken or "burn up" its power]].

### *Election for sowing seed.*

And when you wish to sow seed that you want to thrive for a long time, let the ascendant be a common sign [[notes: Common or "mutable" signs—Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, and Pisces—are associated with change and transition]], and its Lord be in a mobile sign [[notes: Mobile or "cardinal" signs—Aries, Cancer, Libra, and Capricorn—are associated with the start of seasons and initiation]], aspecting the Lord of its own house, and let him be free from the malefics; for if a malefic aspects him, he will find that seed hindered. Let the Moon therefore be increased in light and in number [[notes: Meaning a Waxing Moon, growing toward full]], because if the Moon be under the rays [[notes: "Under the rays" is a condition similar to combustion, where the Moon is too close to the Sun to be seen]] and be deficient in light and number, that seed will vanish, and nothing will be born from it; but if it be as I have told you, with the Moon increased in number, that seed shall be born and established according to the quantity of that which is sown.

## The fifth sign, or the fifth house with its elections, and first in the begetting of a male or female child.

[[notes: In traditional astrology, the Fifth House of a birth chart governs children, pleasure, and procreation.]]

**W**hen you wish to choose an hour for joining—that is, when you wish to be joined to your wife to beget a male son—let the ascendant, its Lord, the Moon, and the Lord of the house of children [[notes: The Lord of the Fifth House]] be in masculine signs, or in the masculine fourth part of the circle at the hour of conjunction; and do not place any but a masculine planet in the ascendant at that same hour, nor in the sign of children. And if you wish it to be a female, let these significators be in feminine signs, and in the feminine part of the circle. But if you cannot do this, and these significators are diverse—that is, if some are in masculine signs and some in feminine—let the Lord of the Hour and the reception of the Moon [[notes: "Reception" occurs when one planet is in a sign ruled by another, suggesting cooperation]] be shared with those who have more testimony in masculine signs, if you wish this, and in the masculine part, and the son shall be according to this.

### *Election for drawing a stillborn birth from the womb.*

And if a child has died in the womb and you wish to draw it out, let this be done when the Moon is deficient in light and number [[notes: A waning Moon, associated with decrease and removal]], descending from the girdle of the signs to the seventh sign—that is, from the Midheaven to the seventh [[notes: The quadrant of the sky between the highest point (noon) and the western horizon (sunset)]]—aspecting the fortunes [[notes: The "fortunes" or benefics are the planets Jupiter and Venus]] from a trine or a square aspect with an aspect from Mars; and it is even more effective, better, and worthier if the sign of the Moon and the ascendant be from the feminine signs which are of direct ascension, and not in tortuous signs [[notes: "Direct" signs (Cancer through Sagittarius) rise more slowly and "straight" over the horizon, whereas "Tortuous" or signs of short ascension (Capricorn through Gemini) rise at a sharp, slanted angle]].

### *Election if you wish to hand a son over to discipline, or to send him to a place where he may be taught some mastery.*

And if you wish to hand a son over to discipline [[notes: Meaning formal education or schooling]], or you wish to send him to a place in which he may be taught some mastery or trade, let your election for this be with the Moon aspecting Mercury, and let them be free from the malefics; and let the ascendant be Gemini or Virgo [[notes: These are the two signs ruled by Mercury, the planet of intellect and communication]]. Let Mercury be oriental and ascending, and not descending, nor retrograde, nor in his first station [[notes: The "station" is the moment a planet appears to stand still before changing direction]], nor in his fall [[notes: The "fall" is the sign where a planet’s influence is considered weakest; for Mercury, this is Pisces]]; and let the Lord of the house of Mercury be likewise. Do not place the Moon descending and deficient in light, because it makes the discipline slow; and let the Lords of their houses be aspecting them.

## The sixth sign, or the sixth house with its elections, and first in expelling devils and phantoms from any place.

[[notes: The Sixth House traditionally governs illness, servants, and small animals, but was also associated with "infestations" or afflictions of the body and home.]]

**W**hen there is a devil in any place or house, or an infestation of evil inhabitants, or if some terrible thing has followed it which is to be feared, or some appearing phantom, and you wish to remove it from its place or from any man by a charm [[notes: *Carmen* can mean a song, an incantation, or a ritual prayer]], or by some inquiry or ingenuity, beware lest the Moon or the ascendant be in any of these signs: namely, in Leo, Cancer, Scorpio, and Aquarius; but let the Moon be in the others outside of these, separated from the malefics and joined to the fortunes.

...of the Moon; but if it cannot be helped that this must be done, let it be from a **trine** or **sextile** aspect [[notes: Astrological "aspects" are angles between planets. Trines (120°) and sextiles (60°) were considered harmonious and lucky.]], without **opposition**, and without the projection of two rays from the fourth [[notes: A square aspect, or 90°, considered stressful.]], or entering under the rays [[notes: "Under the rays" refers to a planet being too close to the Sun, which was thought to "burn up" or weaken its influence.]], because if it is so, it will cause pain and hindrance. If however you desire a **treatment of the head**, and whatever [[margin: **The Head.**]] descends from it, such as a gargle or vomiting [[notes: In humeral medicine, "descending" fluids or "catarrhs" from the head were often treated by purging or induced vomiting.]], let the **Ascendant** be **Aries**, or the Moon in **Aries** or **Taurus**, and let the Moon be decreasing in light, and joined to the **fortunes** [[notes: "Fortunes" refers to the benefic planets, Jupiter and Venus, which bring good luck.]], and beware of the aspect of the **Sun** from the fourth aspect or opposition, specifically in Aries, on account of the heat of the Sun. For **medicines**, however, which are put into the nostrils, such as fumigations and sneezing powders etc., let this be when the Moon is in **Leo** or **Virgo**, joined to the fortunes, and let it not be joined to the **evils** [[notes: "Evils" or malefics refer to Saturn and Mars.]], nor to a **retrograde** planet, nor one that is hindered. And if you desire a treatment of the body, namely the hands and feet, let the Ascendant be **Capricorn**, or **Pisces**, or **Aquarius**, or the Moon in them joined to the fortunes. And if you desire the treatment of some **ancient disease** [[notes: Likely refers to chronic illnesses.]], let your choice for doing this be when the Moon is in **Taurus** and its triplicity [[notes: The "Triplicities" are groups of three signs belonging to the same element; Taurus belongs to the Earth triplicity.]], and Taurus is the best of those, because it is of the diseases of the earth; and let the Moon be clean from the evils, and let the fortunes be in the angles of the Moon from Taurus; it will be stronger and better, so that the old infirmity may recede and not return to the one who suffers it; and beware lest the Moon joins with **Saturn** specifically, because that signifies a prolongation of the infirmity. And **Meffahalach** [[notes: Masha'allah ibn Athari, a famous Persian Jewish astrologer who helped found Baghdad.]] said: Observe in every treatment which part of the body you wish [to treat], for if it is in the part of the head, or the throat, and the chest, treat it when the Moon is in **Aries**, **Taurus**, and **Gemini**, which is the part of the upper things; and if it is in the part of the belly and inside the pubic region, treat it when the Moon is in **Cancer**, **Leo**, and **Virgo**. If indeed the disease is in the lower part, namely in the anus and in the lower part of the body, treat it when the Moon is in **Libra**, **Scorpio**, and **Sagittarius**, and let the Moon be joined to the fortunes, increased in light and in number. And if the disease is from the knee and below even to the foot, treat it when the Moon is in **Capricorn**, **Aquarius**, and **Pisces**. And it is also said that every pain which is from the head to the foot ought to be treated when the Moon is between the **angle of the earth** and the **midheaven** [[notes: The 4th house and 10th house of an astrological chart.]], ascending that is from the angle of the earth even to the midheaven, through this part of the circle. And if it is from the pubic region to the lower part of the feet, you shall treat it when the Moon is between the tenth angle of the earth from the tenth [[notes: A technical description of the Moon's descent through the houses of the chart.]], namely descending to the angle of the earth, which is the part of the lower circle, and let the Ascendant be fortunate; for if it is so, it signifies that he may be healed and profit. And if there is some blister or some matter in the **eye**, and it is necessary that it be [[margin: **The Eyes.**]] touched with **iron** [[notes: "Iron" is a common euphemism for surgical instruments or surgery.]], or scarified, or if there is a covering over it [[notes: Likely referring to cataracts or a pterygium.]], or if it is in any place of the body which must be touched with iron, such as the cutting of a vein [[notes: Phlebotomy or bloodletting.]], etc., let this be when the Moon is increased in light and number, except in bloodletting with **cupping glasses** [[notes: "Ventosis" refers to the practice of cupping.]], because then you shall place the Moon decreasing in light and number, joined to the fortunes, and let **Jupiter** be above the earth in the Ascendant above the earth, or in the 11th, or in the 10th, or 9th; and beware of its conjunction with **Mars** when the Moon is increased in light and number. If however you cannot place Jupiter in these places, let it be looking at [[notes: "Looking at" means forming an aspect with.]] the Ascendant, and beware lest the Moon and the Ascendant be in **fixed signs** and **Gemini** mixed with Mars—that is, having some communion with Mars—and beware then at the rising of the Moon, that is, when the Moon passes the Sun by 12 degrees; similarly in the **prevention** [[notes: "Praeuentione" likely refers to the Syzygy or New Moon preceding the event.]], or let Mars not be in the Ascendant when this happens, and similarly Saturn, unless it is at the beginning of the month and the Moon is increased in light and number; because if you cut anything from the body, or perforate it, they will rot, and the bloodletting or perforation will not profit the patient in their infirmity. And do not cut a vein, nor uproot a tooth, while the Moon is in a **movable** or **common** sign [[notes: Movable signs (Aries, Cancer, Libra, Capricorn) and Common signs (Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Pisces) were thought to be too unstable for surgery.]], unless the Moon is clean from the evils, or a fortune is strong with the Moon, or the Moon is joined to it by a trine or sextile aspect. Regarding pains which are in the eyes, and what happens to them like **phlegmon** [[notes: Inflammation or swelling.]] and **whiteness** [[notes: Often referring to cataracts.]], and other infirmities which are treated with iron, let this be in the increase of the Moon and its number, according to what I told you before this chapter, and let the Moon be clean from Mars in the treatment of the eye specifically; for if he [Mars] should look at it, abstain from this. If indeed Saturn should look at it, then if the Moon is increased in light and number at the beginning of the month, it does not hinder; when however it is far from the prevention, make the Moon look at Mars from a trine aspect, and let it be joined to a fortune, and do not give Mars strength in any treatment of the eyes, because the wise have agreed upon the hindrance of Mars in the head; and they also said, everything...

->### CONCERNING ELECTIONS<-
[[notes: "Elections" is the branch of astrology used to determine the most auspicious time to begin a project, perform a surgery, or enter into a contract.]]

Everything that is treated with iron [[notes: "Iron" here refers to surgical instruments or blades]], observe its power from the body, and do not place the Moon, nor the Ascendant, in this sign. Do not touch anything with iron when the Moon is in a common [[notes: "Common" signs are also known as "Mutable" signs (Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, and Pisces), which are considered unstable]] or mobile sign.

->*An Election for shaving the head with a medicament.*<-

**When** you wish to shave the head with *annora*—that is, to remove hair with a certain kind of medicinal paste [[notes: *Annora* (from the Arabic *al-nūra*) was a caustic depilatory made of lime and orpiment]] or other means—let this be done when the Moon is in feminine signs and waning in light. If you are unable to do this, do not place her in the "hairy" signs, such as Aries and Leo, or the other bestial signs; and let the Lord of the Ascendant be descending from the midheaven toward the "angle of the earth" [[notes: The Fourth House, or the lowest point of the chart, associated with endings and foundations]].

->*An Election for the purchase of servants.*<-

**And** when you wish to make a purchase of servants [[notes: This reflects the historical context of the author, likely drawing on Roman or Medieval sources where slavery was a standard legal institution]], beware that the Moon is not joined to the "malefics" [[notes: Malefics are the planets Mars and Saturn, associated with hardship]], nor that a malefic is below the earth, nor that the Moon is in a mobile sign; for this signifies that the servant will be unfaithful to the master, will not remain stable in one state, or will be a fugitive. If the Moon is separated from the malefics and joined to the "fortunes" [[notes: Fortunes or "benefics" are the planets Jupiter and Venus, associated with good luck]], and she herself is in Libra, this will be useful—indeed, Libra is the most useful for this. In fixed signs, the servant will be patient and enduring, and honored by his master—except for Scorpio, because then he will be a whisperer [[notes: A gossip or slanderer]], an accuser, and weak in his speech. In Leo, he will be greedy, and because of the gluttony of his belly, he will suffer stomach pains and be a thief. Let the Moon be in common signs, for this is praiseworthy, except for Pisces; for in Pisces, he will think of treachery and infidelity toward his masters in his soul, and will disparage them when they are not present. And fear the conjunction of the Moon with the malefics, because when she is joined to them, it signifies that the servant will soon be sold off again.

->*A Question on granting freedom.*<-

**And** when you wish to make a servant free-born [[notes: *Ingenuus* refers to the legal status of a free citizen]], beware of the presence of the Moon in the 12th sign [[notes: The 12th House, associated with imprisonment and "hidden enemies"]], just as it says in the fifth book of Dorotheus [[notes: Dorotheus of Sidon was a highly influential 1st-century Hellenistic astrologer whose work on elections survived through Arabic translations]]. And when you wish to return a servant to freedom, let this be when the Moon is clean of vices, increasing in light and in number, and joined to the fortunes. Let the fortune itself be "oriental" [[notes: Rising before the Sun]] and increasing, because if it is "occidental" [[notes: Setting after the Sun]] and increasing, he will find some good, but pains will happen to him, and he will not cease to fail until he dies. Indeed, when the Moon's light is increasing, if Saturn is in the body and increasing in number, it signifies the anointing of his substance [[notes: Likely referring to the accumulation of personal wealth or property]]. Let the Sun and the sign of the midheaven be clean from malefics; for if they are hindered, the master will find some impediment according to the nature of that sign. Let the hour of liberation be when the "luminaries" [[notes: The Sun and Moon]] behold each other in a trine or sextile aspect [[notes: Harmonious angles of 120 or 60 degrees]], so that there may be concord and affection between the servant and the master, and he will receive good from him. For the "fourth aspect" [[notes: A square, or 90-degree angle]] is middling, and the aspect of opposition signifies that the servant will contend with his master. He who makes a servant free when the Moon is hindered—slavery would have been better for that servant than liberty. Therefore, place the Moon in fixed signs.

->*The seventh sign, or the seventh house, with its elections, and first concerning marriage.*<-

# C
**When** you wish for an election for marriage, beware lest the Moon be in the 12th, and beware lest she be in signs that are not useful for this, which are Aries, Cancer, Libra, Capricorn, and Aquarius [[notes: These are mostly "mobile" or cardinal signs, which were thought to lead to quick changes or instability in a union]]; and beware of the signs in which there are malefics or the "Tail" [[notes: The Dragon's Tail, or South Node of the Moon, considered a point of depletion]]. When you wish to "confirm" a woman [[notes: Likely referring to the legal betrothal or the finalizing of the marriage contract]], let this be when the Moon is joined to the fortunes and in a mobile sign—and the sign of Libra is the best of all those. But beware, in this confirmation, that the Moon is not in a fixed sign. However, in the "conjunction"—that is, when a man enters to his wife to use with her [[notes: A euphemism for the consummation of the marriage]]—beware that the Moon is not in a mobile sign, nor a common one; but let this be when the Moon and the Ascendant are in a fixed sign. Better than the others are Leo and Taurus. Scorpio and Aquarius are useful for the woman. The first half of Taurus is better than its end; however, the first half of Gemini is worse, and its end is good. Aries and Cancer are also bad. Leo is praiseworthy, except that each of the partners will not cease to destroy the substance of their companion. Virgo is useful for a woman who has been married before, but not for a virgin. Libra is also bad. The beginning of Scorpio is useful, and its end is bad, for it signifies that their society will not be prolonged. Sagittarius is also bad, and similarly the beginning of Capricorn, though its middle and end are good. Aquarius is also bad, and Pisces likewise. There is no utility in a marriage when Venus beholds the malefics; let the marriage take place when Venus is in the houses of the fortunes [[notes: Signs ruled by Jupiter, like Sagittarius or Pisces, or her own signs]] and joined to the lord of her house in their "terms" [[notes: Specific degrees of a sign]]. If, however, the lord of her house is a malefic, let her be separated from him, and let Jupiter be

Of these, the trine aspect is better, especially in the **water triplicity** [[notes: The three zodiac signs associated with water: Cancer, Scorpio, and Pisces]]. Let the Moon be increasing in light and in number [[notes: Meaning a waxing moon, which was considered "fertile" or growing in power]], free from "evils" [[notes: "Evils" or "malifics" usually refer to the influence of Mars or Saturn]], and let Venus always be in her **exaltation** [[notes: A sign where a planet's influence is strongest; for Venus, this is Pisces]], or her triplicity, or her **joy** [[notes: A specific house where a planet is said to be particularly happy or effective]], or in conjunction with Jupiter or Mercury, and let Mercury be fortunate and strong. Similarly, prepare the Sun as we have told you before, because from the Sun and the **ascendant** [[notes: The sign rising on the eastern horizon at a specific moment]] the condition of the man is known; and from Venus, the Moon, and the **seventh sign** [[notes: The descendant, representing the "other" or the spouse]], the condition of the woman is known. Therefore, beware of the aspect of "malifics" toward them from a conjunction, a **fourth aspect** [[notes: A square, or 90-degree angle, considered stressful]], or from an opposition. And if it is a married woman, let the Moon be in **common signs** [[notes: Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, or Pisces]], and work according to what I told you; let the ascendant at the hour of marriage be from the signs I told you, or let the Moon be in them. Do not place any of the malifics in the ascendant, nor let them look upon it with enmity. Let one of the **fortunes** [[notes: Benefic planets, usually Jupiter or Venus]] be in the **Midheaven** [[notes: The highest point in the sky; the 10th house]]. **Dorothius** [[notes: Dorotheus of Sidon, a 1st-century astrological poet often cited by Sahl]] said: because then a son will be granted to them in the same year they are joined; and if a "fortune" is at the degree of the Midheaven, the woman will conceive at the first union.

### ->*Election for going out to war.*<-

In the knowledge of the hours for going out to war, it is necessary that you place one of the houses of the higher planets in the ascendant—the strongest of which is the **house of Mars** [[notes: Aries or Scorpio]]—when it is in a sextile or trine aspect to the ascendant. Let the **lord of the ascendant** [[notes: The planet that rules the rising sign]] be in the ascendant or in the **eleventh house** [[notes: The house of allies and hopes]]. Beware of the fourth, sixth, seventh, eighth, and ninth houses. Let it not be **combust** [[notes: So close to the Sun that its power is "burned up"]], nor "falling," nor joined to a falling planet that does not receive it. Make the lord of the ascendant join the lord of the seventh house, or place him in the ascendant, or in the second house with Mars. And if you wish for them to be joined, make them join in the **angles** [[notes: The 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses, which are the most powerful]], so that they may meet each other and war shall break out between them. Place a "fortune" holding a part in the ascendant against Mars, so that it may block him from the ascendant. And do not go to war unless Mars is in an aspect of friendship with the lord of the ascendant, or is the lord of the ascendant himself, and is strong in a good place, neither hindered nor combust, and in signs of **direct ascension**. Beware not to place him anywhere except in the **haiz** [[notes: A complex condition where a planet is in a sign and hemisphere that matches its gender and sect (day or night)]] of the ascendant, so that his help may be toward the one you send to war. Prepare the Moon as well when you send soldiers to war, for they shall be delivered by God’s command. Also, prepare the **second house** and its lord for the soldiers beginning the attack, and the **eighth house** and its lord for the enemy's soldiers. Do not place the lord of the eighth in the seventh nor in the eighth, but place the lord of the eighth in the second or eleventh. Place the **Part of Fortune** [[notes: A calculated mathematical point in a chart representing success]] and its lord in the ascendant or the second, and do not place them in the eighth or seventh. Do not have the ascendant or its lord hindered when you begin this matter. Similarly, respect the dignity of the **twelfth Moon** [[notes: Likely referring to the 12th lunar mansion or a specific lunar day]]. For in the matter of war, it is necessary to prepare the stars of war—that is, Mars and Mercury—and also the Moon and the lord of its house. Look, therefore, to the preparation of these; do not be negligent in this, nor let them be forgotten. And know that when you have wisely led both armies to war as I have described, the victory will be obtained by the one who was born at night, and in whose **nativity** [[notes: Birth chart]] Mars held a part, because Mars is the lord of wars and wars are committed to him. Perhaps they will even be pacified, or will give up the war, if the place of their departure to war was good.

### ->*Election in buying, or borrowing or returning instruments of war, and in de/*<-
### ->*stroying any place or any instrument.*<-

When you wish to buy arms and instruments of war, let this be when Mars is in his own house, or in his exaltation or triplicity at the end of the month; for the wise ones take care that the Moon is not with Mars at the beginning of the month, as it is more useful at the end. And if you wish to destroy your own camp, let the beginning be when Mars is **unfortunate** [[notes: In a weak or afflicted position]], having no strength. When you wish to destroy any instrument of war, begin this when Mercury is hindered and without strength. When you wish to destroy land, begin when the Moon is unfortunate and without strength. When you wish to destroy an opposition in war, let it be when Mars is hindered and without strength. And when you wish to destroy a place of **idols** [[notes: Historically, this often referred to non-Islamic or non-Christian religious sites depending on the reader's context]] or a place in which prayer is offered, let it be when Venus is hindered and without strength.

-> ON ELECTIONS <-

### *The eighth sign, or the eighth house, with its elections.*

# **W**
hen a person wishes to settle their affairs or entrust something to another, they should not begin this while the Ascendant [[notes: The zodiac sign rising on the eastern horizon]] or the sign of the Moon are in "moveable" signs [[notes: Aries, Cancer, Libra, and Capricorn, which signify change and instability]], for this indicates that the trust itself may be annulled. Rather, let it be entrusted when the Moon is decreasing in its daily motion but increasing in light [[notes: waxing toward a full moon]], and let the Moon not be joined to a planet "under the rays" [[notes: 'Combust,' or so close to the Sun that its power is scorched or hidden]], for this signifies a swift death. This is even more dangerous when the Moon is with Mars, or in its fourth or opposite aspect, or if Mars is in the Ascendant or regards it with enmity [[notes: a square or opposition aspect]]. Such a configuration signifies that the trust will not only be annulled, but the sick person will die of that very illness, and the trust will not be fulfilled after their death. Conversely, when Saturn is with the Moon in the Ascendant in a similar way, the man’s life will be prolonged, and the trust will be fulfilled after him, being annulled neither in his life nor after his death. If Jupiter and Venus are positioned in the same way toward the Moon and the Ascendant as the lord of that trust, he will finish his life peacefully and the trust will be carried out.

### *The ninth sign, or the ninth house, with its elections; and first concerning travels.*

# **D**
o not neglect to direct your travels according to the person's nativity [[notes: their birth chart]], specifically the ascensions of the birth and its angles [[notes: the 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th houses]]. Let the Moon be in the birth Ascendant or in the Midheaven [[notes: the highest point of the chart]]. Align the Lord of the matter you seek, the Lord of the Year (that is, the sign of the profession), the Lord of the natal Ascendant, and the Lord of the "Revolution" [[notes: the Solar Return chart for that year]]. If you are ignorant of what I have said, look to the person who comes to you and see where the "Lord of the thing sought" is located in relation to the Lord of the Ascendant. After this, show him the hour, choosing one similar to his nativity or the "interrogation" [[notes: a horary chart cast for the moment a question is asked]]. That is: do not place the Ascendant of the interrogation and its Lord "falling" [[notes: in a weak house]] from the Ascendant of the departure. Let the Ascendant of the departure be the tenth house of the interrogation or nativity if you seek a kingdom. If you seek business, let it be the eleventh house from the Ascendant of the interrogation. 

Similarly, in every matter you seek, make that specific sign the Ascendant. Let the Moon be in the "angles" or the "succedent" houses [[notes: the 2nd, 5th, 8th, or 11th houses]]. If she is free from "evils" [[notes: bad aspects from Mars or Saturn]], let her look toward the Ascendant. If, however, she is afflicted, let her "fall" from the Ascendant [[notes: be placed in a weak house like the 6th, 8th, or 12th]]. Let the Lord of the Ascendant and the Lord of the Moon’s house be in the angles, and let the Moon look toward the Lord of her own house. Take care not to place the Moon with the "evils" or in their aspect (specifically the square or opposition), for the aspect of the "evils" to the Ascendant is lighter than their aspect to the Moon during the first journey. Conjunctions with Mars at the start of the month signify thieves or fire. Always avoid placing the Moon in the fourth house; put her in the fifth, for if she is fortunate there, the labor of the journey will be less, the profit will be great, and there will be more progress with less wear on the body, making the journey easier and safer. 

The presence of the Moon in the Ascendant during entry or exit is also terrible, for the traveler fears illness or heavy physical labor during the journey. If the journey is to a King, place the Moon joined to the Sun or the Lord of the Midheaven in a trine or sextile aspect [[notes: harmonious 120-degree or 60-degree angles]], and let the Sun be in a good place in the Ascendant, or the 11th or 10th houses; if it is so, he shall find good. If it is in the 9th, 3rd, or 5th, it signifies labor and meager profit. Similarly, the western angle [[notes: the 7th house]] and the fourth signify little good, with delay and toil. If you seek nobles, judges, or "authors of sects" (that is, bishops and such), let the conjunction of the Moon be with Jupiter in the angles or in a good place from the Ascendant. If your departure is for warriors, let the Moon be joined to Mars in trine or sextile; avoid a direct conjunction or placing them in the angles, but let it be in *Haiz* [[notes: an Arabic astrological term for a planet in a favorable sect and sign]] in the succedent houses. If you depart for the elderly or the low-born, let the Moon be joined to Saturn in friendship [[notes: a good aspect]], with Saturn in a succedent house. If you depart for women, join the Moon to Venus and let it be in a masculine sign. If you depart for writers, merchants, or scholars, let the conjunction be with Mercury, but beware that Mercury is not then "under the rays" [[notes: combust]], nor retrograde, nor aspected by "evils." For whenever the star to which the Moon is joined (or the planet opposite the Ascendant, or the Lord of the 7th) is slow, retrograde, or afflicted, it signifies

If, however, the journey is to be by water, let the Moon be in the signs of water [[notes: Cancer, Scorpio, or Pisces]], free from the malefics [[notes: "Bad" planets, specifically Saturn and Mars]], and let the Ascendant [[notes: The zodiac sign rising on the eastern horizon at the moment of departure]] of the departure be clear, and let it not be with Saturn. And in a journey by water, beware the conjunction of the Moon with Saturn from an angle [[notes: A powerful position in the astrological chart, such as the 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses]], and beware of Saturn; let him not be in a water sign, and let him not be fixed in the Ascendant of departure or with the Moon. If it cannot be helped, at least let the Moon be joined to a "fortune" [[notes: A "benefic" or lucky planet, like Jupiter or Venus]], or in aspect to one through a trine or sextile [[notes: Harmonious angles of 120 or 60 degrees]], or from an angle, so that it might take away the malice of Saturn—whether from shipwreck, a physical hindrance, or a grave storm. Also, in voyaging by sea, do not place the luminaries [[notes: The Sun and Moon]] in a hindered state; for if they are well-placed and safe from the malefics—even if they are not specifically blessed by the "fortunes"—it signifies safety and prosperity. If indeed they are hindered, the man himself will be dead or lost in his travels; do not sail the sea when the Moon is in the "dark phase" of Saturn [[notes: A period of conjunction or negative influence]], for this is a horrible thing. If, however, you sail the sea for the sake of business, specifically prepare Mercury and the Moon, and let them be looking toward a place in Cancer or Pisces. For Scorpio is a horrible sign for voyaging by sea because it is the home of Mars and contains his enmity toward those who sail. Also, fear the "terms" [[notes: Specific degrees of a sign ruled by a certain planet]] of the malefics in sea travel, because in coastal travel there is less danger than in voyaging upon the deep sea. And if the journey is to be on land, let the Moon *not* be in the water signs, but cleansed of the malefics. And beware the aspect of Mars in coastal travel, just as I warned you to beware of Saturn in sea travel. And beware that no journey is begun, in whatever way, while the Moon is in Scorpio. Know that the earth signs are healthier for one who wishes to travel by land, and the water signs for one who wishes to sail the sea. Saturn is of greater hindrance in the sea, and all the more so if he does not look upon Jupiter [[notes: If Jupiter does not "soften" Saturn's influence with a positive aspect]]. Beware of travel by land or sea when the Moon is in the final part of the sign of Libra. Know all of this.

->### *Election for a traveler entering a region or city.*<-

Regarding the preparation of a region for the entry of a traveler: know that it is necessary, when you wish to prepare for the region you are entering, to prepare the "second from the Ascendant" [[notes: The 2nd House, often associated with resources or immediate future]] at the moment you enter whatever region or city you wish. When you have done this, you have prepared the region. You must also prepare the Ascendant and its Lord, and the Moon, and the Lord of the second house, if you can. Place that Lord, therefore, as a "fortune," and let it be above the earth in the ninth, tenth, or eleventh house; never place it below the earth—that is, in the fourth, fifth, or sixth house—because this is horrible for travel and for every work you seek to do in that region. Let it be above the earth, whether it be a "fortune" or a malefic, and strive to have the Lord of the Moon with the Lord of the second house above the earth. Do not place them below the earth, for this is not praiseworthy, unless the thing you seek in that region is a matter you wish to hide, so that it does not appear until it is finished. In that case, let the Moon be between 12 and 15 degrees from the Sun; and see to it that the Moon is fortunate from the time it leaves the Sun's rays until it reaches three degrees, for this is better and more praiseworthy for anything you need to keep hidden. And if you seek power [[notes: *Regnum*, literally "a kingdom"]] in that region, prepare the Midheaven [[notes: The highest point in the chart, the 10th house]] and its Lord, along with the second house from the Ascendant and the Moon. After this, look at travels according to what Dorotheus [[notes: Dorotheus of Sidon, a 1st-century astrological poet much respected by later Arabic and Latin writers]] said: "In travel by water, look to the place of the Moon in the signs." If she is in the first "face" [[notes: A 10-degree segment of a sign]] of Aries, whether the planets look upon her or not, it signifies the capability of the matter. If she is in Taurus, there will be less hindrance from Mars. If, however, Saturn looks upon her, he will hinder the traveler and cause him shipwreck. In the second face of Gemini, it signifies slowness, followed by safety. In Cancer, safety from every hindrance. In Leo, however, predict hindrance, and all the more so if a malefic looks upon it. In Virgo, predict prosperity, slowness, and an eventual return. In Libra, when the Moon has passed 10 degrees, you shall not travel by land or sea. In Scorpio, predict sadness. In Sagittarius, say that before the journey is finished, the traveler shall return. In the beginning of Capricorn, a small amount of good. In Aquarius, predict slowness and safety. In Pisces, predict hindrance and destruction; if a malefic looks upon it, it will increase the harm. If, however, a "fortune" looks upon it, the hindrance will be improved and the good will be strengthened. Know this.

->### *The tenth sign, or the tenth house, with its elections; and first, on going*<-
->### *with a king to a region which he rules.*<-

**W**hen you wish to set out with a king or a prince to a region which he already rules, let this be done when Jupiter is in the Ascendant, or in the 9th house, because this signifies that he who goes [[margin: will find/attain]] [[notes: The sentence is completed by the catchword "ueniet" at the bottom right, suggesting the traveler will find success or reach his goal.]]

-># ON ELECTIONS<-

[[notes: In astrology, an "election" is the process of choosing a specific moment in time to start an activity so that the planetary positions favor a successful outcome.]]

...goodness and joy will come on that journey, and he shall see what pleases him. But beware that you do not place Jupiter in the fourth house [[notes: The fourth house represents the home, the end of matters, and hidden things; Jupiter here was sometimes seen as "buried" or signifying a difficult end in specific travel contexts]], for this is a terrible thing. Let the Moon bear witness to him from one of the angles [[notes: The "angles" are the 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th houses, the strongest points in a chart]], as well as Venus. Beware that Saturn and Mars are not in the ascendant [[notes: The rising sign]], nor in any of the angles, nor Venus. Do not place the Moon "under the rays" [[notes: "Under the rays" or "combust" means the Moon is too close to the Sun, which was thought to weaken its power or "burn it up"]], and beware that it is not with the malifics [[notes: "Malifics" refers to the planets Saturn and Mars, traditionally associated with hardship]], for there is no good in this. Indeed, if he should go on a journey then, he shall not return; if he falls ill, he shall die; and if he goes to war, he shall be killed or conquered.

### *An election for elevation to kingship.*
And when you wish to be elevated and moved toward kingship, let this be with the ascension of Leo, and let the Sun be in Taurus in the Midheaven [[notes: The "Medium Coeli" or 10th house, representing public status and career]], and let the Moon be in the ascendant, joined to the fortunes [[notes: The "fortunes" or benefics are Jupiter and Venus]], or to the lord of the Midheaven.

### *An election for placing a king upon the seat of empire.*
And when you wish to introduce a king to the seat of his empire, let the ascending sign be a "fixed" sign [[notes: Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, or Aquarius, chosen here to ensure the reign is long-lasting and stable]] and likewise the fourth house. Let the lord of the Midheaven be free from the malifics, and the lord of the ascendant be received in a good place. Let the lord of the 10th house not look upon the 11th out of enmity [[notes: "Looking" refers to an aspect or geometric relationship between planets; "enmity" usually refers to a square or opposition aspect]]. Let the Moon look upon the lord of its own house out of friendship [[notes: A trine or sextile aspect]], and let the lord of the fourth sign also look upon the fortunes. If, however, you are unable to do what I have said above, let the Moon be "received" and the lord of the fourth be in a strong place, looking upon the fortunes. If you still cannot do this, make him fall from the ascendant and its aspect, and place the fortunes so they are looking upon the fourth sign and the Midheaven.

### *An election for making a prefect over revenues.*
And when you wish to choose an hour to appoint a prefect over revenues [[notes: A tax collector or financial administrator]], let the Moon be joined to Saturn at the start of the month out of friendship, and let it be in the house of Saturn and the fortunes, with them looking upon it; for this signifies stability and that the work shall be enduring. Let the Midheaven be a fixed sign, so that the work may be consistent.

### *An election for confirming a princedom.*
And when you wish to confirm a princedom or a dukedom, let the Moon be fortified in the houses of Mars [[notes: Aries or Scorpio]], and let it look upon Mars with affection, joined with the fortunes at the end of the month. The more the Moon is "clean" [[notes: Free from bad aspects or "afflictions" from malefic planets]], the more worthy that confirmation of the dukedom (which is below a kingdom) shall be. Let it not be in the houses of the malifics, nor in Cancer, unless the Moon is clean in this regard to the lord of war [[notes: Mars]]. Let this be in the houses of Mars; and of those, Scorpio is better and more useful because of the strength of Mars and his stability within it.

### *An election for making an enemy of a king.*
And if you wish to be an enemy to a king, and you are the one who is the adversary, let this be when the Moon is increasing in light [[notes: A waxing moon]], and let the Moon and the ascendant be clean from malifics. Let the lord of the ascendant be in an optimal place from the ascendant, in one of its own dignities, direct [[notes: Not in retrograde motion]], and safe from the malifics—whether it be a fortune or a malific. Let the lord of the seventh house [[notes: The house of open enemies]] be in a bad place from the ascendant, looking upon neither a fortune nor the luminaries [[notes: The Sun and Moon]].

### *An election for mollifying a king angry at you.*
If, however, a king is angry at you or has become an enemy, do not appear before him unless the Moon is decreasing in light [[notes: A waning moon]] as well as the ascendant, and its lord and the Moon are "impeded" [[notes: Weakened by bad aspects or position]]. Let the lord of the seventh house be fortunate and in a good place from the ascendant, so that this may be stronger for your affairs.

### *The eleventh sign, or the eleventh house, with its elections, and first on making friendship.*
**W**hen you wish to make a friendship with someone, let the Moon be clean from the angles of the malifics, and let the lord of the 11th house [[notes: The house of friends and alliances]] look upon the ascendant out of friendship. Place the Moon joined to the substance of the planet whom you seek: such as Venus for women, and Mercury for scribes and all circles, according to what follows from this.

### *An election for requesting a certain thing from any man.*
And when you wish to request a certain thing from any man, let the lord of the ascendant look upon the ascendant out of friendship. Let the ascendant be a fixed or common sign, and let the lord of the ascendant be in it, or in its triplicity, or in a fourth aspect [[notes: A square aspect, though usually considered difficult, is specified here in some traditional systems for specific results]]. Beware of the opposition, and that the Moon is not joined to the malifics, and that it does not fail to look upon the lord of its own house. For if the Moon does not look upon the lord of its house, the thing itself will not be completed. Therefore, always seek things when the Moon is increasing in light and number [[notes: Moving faster than its average daily motion]], with the lord of the ascendant being direct, and the Moon joined to the fortunes. If, however...
