-> ## ON NATIVITIES <-

...or outside the **angles** [[notes: The "angles" are the 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th houses of a zodiac chart, considered the most powerful positions.]]. Know that when a **benefic** [[notes: *Fortunae* refers to "fortunate" planets, specifically Jupiter and Venus.]] aspects the **Alcochoden** [[notes: A term derived from Arabic astrology referring to the planet that determines the length of a person's life.]], and it is not **under the sun's rays** [[notes: A planet "under the rays" is too close to the Sun to be seen, which usually weakens its influence.]], they increase the life-span and give him its **lesser years**. And know that when the Alcochoden is **combust** [[notes: "Combust" is a more severe version of being under the rays, within about 8.5 degrees of the Sun, traditionally thought to "burn up" the planet's power.]], and signifies nothing, and **Venus** or **Jupiter** are in the nativity in the **ascendant** [[notes: The point of the zodiac rising on the eastern horizon at the moment of birth.]], or in the **midheaven** [[notes: The highest point of the chart.]], or even one of them, it is hoped that the native will live according to the lesser years of Venus or Jupiter. But if the benefics grant anything to the Alcochoden by aspect, it will increase the life-span by months or days according to the number of their lesser years when it is hindered or occupied. Know also that when the benefics aspect by a **square** [[notes: A 90-degree aspect, usually considered stressful, but here the author notes it does not diminish the life-span when coming from a "fortunate" planet.]] or **opposition**, or are with the Alcochoden, they do not cut anything away—that is, they do not take years away—but rather increase the lesser years, provided they are not **retrograde** [[notes: Appearing to move backward in the sky.]] or combust, or hindered by the **malefics** [[notes: *Mali* refers to "bad" planets, specifically Saturn and Mars.]]. When the Alcochoden is in the angles, whether **oriental** [[notes: Rising before the Sun.]] or not, if it is neither retrograde nor combust, it will give its **greater years** by the command of God. When it is not in such a state, and is **cadent** [[notes: Falling away from the angles, usually the 3rd, 6th, 9th, or 12th houses, considered weak positions.]], it will give its lesser years. And if a benefic aspects the Alcochoden, it will increase its lesser years. This is true if it is retrograde but not combust. However, if it is retrograde or combust, it will give a number of months equal to its lesser years. And if the malefics aspect the Alcochoden by opposition or square, or are not with it in the same sign, they will diminish the life-span according to their lesser years, whether they **receive** [[notes: "Reception" is a dignification where one planet is in a sign ruled by the other.]] it or not. However, when a malefic aspects the Alcochoden by a **trine** or **sextile** aspect [[notes: Harmonious aspects of 120 or 60 degrees.]], and they occupy it without the aspect of the benefics, then that malefic will diminish the life-span according to its lesser years. When the Alcochoden is with the **Tail** [[notes: *Cauda Draconis*, the South Node of the Moon, traditionally associated with loss or decrease.]] and is itself malefic, and there are twelve degrees or less between it and the Tail, it diminishes the years assigned to the Alcochoden by a fourth part. But when the **Head** [[notes: *Caput Draconis*, the North Node, associated with increase.]] is with the Alcochoden, and the Alcochoden is a benefic, and there are twelve degrees between it and the Alcochoden, this will increase the years of the Alcochoden by a fourth part. Regarding the circumstances involved in the granting of lesser, greater, or mean years, you must consider your calculation of which planets have impediments—beyond falling and retrogradation and combustion—from the opposition or square of malefics and their conjunction. I have also shown you how they hinder it, and how retrogradation diminishes it by one degree from the order, and combustion similarly by another. Furthermore, if they are joined upon it—retrogradation or combustion without falling—he will not taste anything until he dies.

### **S** un, when it is with the Alcochoden in conjunction or opposition, or in a square aspect, similarly cuts away from its lesser years. From a trine or sextile, if it aspects the Alcochoden, it adds its lesser years to it. And if it were joined to it or opposite, or in its square aspect, and there were **reception** there, it would diminish the same by months or days according to its lesser years, if God wills.

### **W** hen the Alcochoden is positioned **under the rays**, it will be as if blind; it will not be able to receive an increase from the benefics, because it does not see them nor do they see it, unless it is with the Sun in one degree [[notes: This describes the "Cazimi" position, or being "in the heart of the Sun," which was considered a position of immense accidental strength.]], because there it is as fortunate as can be—that is, under the Sun in one degree—whether the Alcochoden is a malefic or a benefic. Also, when a planet has been "worked," it will not increase the Alcochoden except by a small amount. The **Moon**, however, is received by the Sun, because she receives light from him from every house; but when she is received from an opposition, she loses half of the reception. If, however, she is received in her own house or **exaltation** [[notes: A sign where a planet's influence is particularly strong and honored.]], there will be two receptions. The Sun diminishes the years of the Alcochoden all the more, whether he be oriental or occidental. If he is in the angles or in the **succedent houses** [[notes: Houses 2, 5, 8, and 11, which follow the angles.]] and is malefic by his exaltation, term, or triplicity, he signifies his greater years, because he is of an oriental or occidental substance. When a benefic aspects the Alcochoden from an opposition and is retrograde and weak due to the hindrance of malefics, it cannot—by the will of God—add anything except months according to the number of its lesser years, if God wills.

### **T** he **Lot of the Father and Mother** [[notes: *Pars patris & matris*; these are mathematical points in a chart used to determine the fate or lifespan of the parents.]] are directed toward knowing their lives through **ascensions** [[notes: A method of timing events (Primary Directions) where degrees are equated to years.]] to the bodies of malefics, and their rays from the number of degrees—specifically, one year for every single degree—whether any of the four aspects them: that is, the Lord, or the **terms**, or the [[margin: exaltation]].

->SECOND BOOK.<- [[page number: 127]]

...with gifts and tripled actions.
**Y**ou shall direct for the newborn the degree of the ascendant, whether it be the *hylech* [[notes: The *hylech* is the 'Giver of Life,' a specific point in a birth chart used to determine the native's lifespan and vital force.]], toward each degree by [zodiacal] ascensions for each year, until the rays of the malefics or benefics [[notes: 'Malefics' (Saturn and Mars) were thought to bring hardship, while 'benefics' (Jupiter and Venus) brought luck.]] in the root of the nativity [[notes: The 'root' or 'radix' refers to the original positions of the planets at the exact moment of birth.]]. And in the revolution of the year, direct the degrees of the ascendant to know its state through equal degrees toward the rays of the benefics and the houses of the malefics; and you shall set each 59 minutes and 8 seconds as one whole day, if God wills. 

And you shall direct to know the greater matters of the native from the sign of profection [[notes: Profection is an ancient timing technique where the Ascendant is moved forward by one full zodiac sign for every year of life.]]. And know that the sign of profection is always similar to the degree of the ascendant, because every 30 degrees constitutes a year. For it is similar to the ascendant of the root, an example of which is this: if the ascendant of the root was 10 degrees of the sign of Aries, the sign of profection will therefore be the degrees of Taurus in the second year. Similarly, for each year there is always one sign, if God wills. 

Similarly, when one wishes to know his greater matters, multiply the degrees of the sign of profection and the rays of the malefics and benefics—that is, the degrees which are between the degree of the sign of profection and the rays—multiply them by seven degrees and a sixth part of one; and according to the number of those days, the state of the native shall be changed from good to evil, or from evil to good, according to the nature of the lord of the rays, whether it be a benefic or a malefic. 

And you shall direct to know the state of the father every day from the degree of the fathers—that is, from the degree of the fourth house [[notes: In traditional astrology, the fourth house governs the father, ancestors, and hidden treasures.]]—to the bodies of the benefics and malefics and their rays; and you shall set every 59 minutes and 8 seconds as one day. It shall be told in the event according to the quantity of the malefics and benefics, and the places in which they were, and the relevance of the places through their dominion over the twelve signs; because whatever sign a planet regards—that is, from its own signs—it brings the nature of that sign. But that which does not regard the sign [brings] the likeness of its nature, both in vision, desire, and thought, if God wills. 

And you shall direct to know the greater matters of the father from the sign of profection—that is, from the house of the father, from the Lot of the Father [[notes: A 'Lot' or 'Arabic Part' is a mathematical point found by measuring the distance between two planets and adding it to the Ascendant.]]—from the number of all 30 degrees. For you shall direct what lies between the aforesaid [points] and the rays of the malefics and benefics, and you shall multiply those degrees which were between the aforesaid and the rays of the malefics and benefics by 12 degrees and 10 minutes; and that which results will be the number of days which shall signify accidents of evil or [good], according to the nature of the lord of the rays and the relevance of the places to him. 

And you shall direct from the Lot of the Mother in the root of the nativity toward the rays of the benefics or malefics, and every degree through ascensions shall be a year, to know her life; this shall be regarding her life. However, in the greater state of the same mother, you shall direct it from the root of the nativity for every 30 equal [degrees] as a year, just as you do for the father in his greater state; you shall direct for the mother the degree of the Moon for every 30 minutes and 8 [seconds] as a whole day. 

Now I will set down for you an example, through which you may always direct; because as you proceed, I have observed the directions of this nativity: the ascendant was 5 degrees of Taurus, and none of the planets were in it, nor were their rays more than 5 degrees away, except for the Moon. However, the Moon was in a sextile aspect [[notes: A sextile is a harmonious 60-degree angle between two points in the zodiac.]] to the ascendant—specifically in Cancer at 24 degrees and 5 minutes. [Subtracting] the 5 degrees of the ascendant from the 24 degrees of the Moon’s rays in the ascendant, 19 degrees remained. We said, therefore, that the ascendant would govern for 19 days until it reached the disposition of the Moon through the rays of its sextile aspect. After this, the Moon governs for the completion of thirty degrees from the ascendant, and from the second [house], two [degrees], completing nine degrees until it reaches the light of the rays of the sextile aspect of Saturn. Then Saturn will receive the disposition through the light of the sextile aspect of Venus, because Venus was the planet closest to the rays of Saturn after Saturn itself. We therefore subtracted the degrees of Saturn from Venus, and four degrees remained. We said, therefore, that Saturn would govern for four days; after this, we subtracted [Venus] from Mercury, and eight days remained. Then we subtracted Mercury from Jupiter, and thirteen remained; we said that Mercury would govern for thirteen days. After this, we subtracted the twenty-seven degrees of Jupiter from thirty, and three days in Gemini remained. Let it be done similarly until the completion of the twelve houses. And if any planet should regard the degree of the ascendant from an identical degree, there would be no disposition for the ascendant, but it would be the disposition of the planet, because it would occupy the minute of the planet. Operate the ascendant in this way when you revolve the year from the ascendant until the ascendant also returns, if God wills; and thus you shall do to know the state, and in this way you shall direct from...

->ON BIRTH CHARTS<-

...at the degree according to the house of the fathers, and for the father and mother from the degree of the moon, in order to know the lesser years.
**M**essahallah [[notes: Masha'allah ibn Athari (c. 740–815 AD) was an influential Persian-Jewish astrologer in the early Islamic Caliphate; his works were highly prized in medieval Europe.]] said, directing from the "ray" [[notes: A "ray" refers to the astrological aspect or influence cast by a planet onto another point.]] of the lord of the exaltation of the ascendant, or the lord of the triplicity [[notes: A group of three zodiac signs belonging to the same element (Fire, Earth, Air, or Water).]], or the "term" [[notes: "Terms" or "Bounds" are specific, unequal subdivisions of each zodiac sign ruled by a particular planet.]] of that same ascendant—specifically from the rays of the planet whose aspect is closer to the degree of the ascendant. While this opinion is not considered "authentic" (standard), because it is possible that none of these four planets aspects the ascendant, or the grandfather, or the grandmother, or the house of the fathers, or the degrees of these places, it is still necessary for us to calculate directions from them. If God wills, you shall use the sign of the profection [[notes: A "profection" is a symbolic timing technique where a point in the chart, such as the Ascendant, moves 30 degrees (one sign) for every year of life.]] to know the "greater years" until the completion of the year. And to find the greater years of the part of the father and mother from the profection of the father, if God wills.

**I** likewise examined another figure [[notes: An "astrological figure" is another term for a horoscope chart.]], and the ascendant of the birth was at the 20th degree of the sign of Gemini, and the sign of the profection in the 5th year reached the 20th degree of Libra. We wish, with God’s help, to know the state of the native in that year from the number provided—namely, that 30 degrees are given to one year by the rays. We subtracted the smaller from the larger [[notes: The Latin "minimus minorem de maiori" is a common instructional phrase for simple subtraction in medieval math.]], then multiplied by 12, and the result was 59 minutes and 8 seconds for one day. For the "least" of the profection sign, which are the 20 degrees of the sign of Libra from Jupiter, four remained; we multiplied the four that remained by twelve, and the result was four degrees. We said, therefore, that he shall govern the smallest of these days through the light of the conjunction of Jupiter, and through the light of the sextile aspect [[notes: A harmonious aspect where two planets are 60 degrees apart.]] of the moon for four degrees. Then we subtracted Jupiter from the moon, and there were five degrees between them, which we multiplied by twelve, reaching 60 degrees; and we said that Jupiter shall govern 60 days through the light of the sextile aspect of the moon. After this, we subtracted the degree of the moon, which is the 28th of the profection sign, and one remained. Then we looked at the other sign, and behold, Mars was casting his light into it according to the degree. We took that degree which remained in the profection sign and the two degrees of the sign and multiplied by 12, which resulted in 36 days, and this was the period ruled by the moon. After this, we subtracted Mars, who is in degrees from the sun, and 3 degrees remained, which we multiplied by 12, resulting in 31 days. We said that Mars would govern these days through the light of the opposition [[notes: An aspect where two planets are 180 degrees apart, often considered challenging.]] of the sun. Again, we multiplied the 15 degrees which remained from the profection sign (out of the profection of 30) by 12, and it came to 180. We said, therefore, that the sun will govern by the nature of "fulfillments" for 180 days. And if the sun were at the 15th degree, and we subtracted Mars from it, 18 would remain. And if the year ended at the 15th, we would cast away three and multiply 15 by 12, and the period would be governed by Mars through the light of the opposition of the sun until the year ended, if God wills. Observe here, therefore, that you shall do this through the "root" [[notes: The "root" (radix) is the original birth chart used as the starting point for all calculations.]] of the birth until life is ended, for each degree a year by the ascensions; in this same way, you shall also do for the father and the mother.

**W**e have directed the ascendant to know the state of the native in this way through the ascensions [[notes: "Ascensions" refer to the time it takes for a degree of the zodiac to rise above the horizon, used here to calculate the length of life.]]. When you wish to know the state of the native by universal knowledge with the nod of God, you shall always direct the degree of the ascendant and not from any other. We looked, therefore, and the ascendant was at the 15th degree of Capricorn, and Jupiter was at that same degree—that is, in the very degree of the ascendant. We directed the degree of Jupiter, because there was no need to look further for the ascendant. You should do the same whenever you see anything similar to this in any place. We looked to see which of the planets was closer to Jupiter among those that were ahead of it and had more degrees. It was Mars at 18 degrees. We therefore subtracted Jupiter from Mars, and three degrees resulted. We said, therefore, that Jupiter would govern for three years through the light of the opposition of Mars. Then we subtracted Mars from Venus, which was at the 20th degree, and two resulted. We said that Mars would govern for two years through the light of the conjunction of Venus. After this, we subtracted Venus from the ascending sign; 10 degrees remained from the ascending sign, and it reached the sun in the second sign at the 10th degree. We said that Venus will govern for 10 years by her own nature, and 10 years by the nature of the sun. Then we subtracted the sun from Jupiter, and 5 degrees remained; we said that the sun will govern for 5 years by the nature of Jupiter. In this way you shall always proceed until it is finished—that is, he speaks of the person's state, assigning for each degree one year by the ascensions, if God wills.

**A**lso look to the lord of the term of the ascendant, for he is the *Algebuhat* [[notes: A Latinization of an Arabic term (likely *al-juz' bakht* or *al-qasīm*), which means "The Divider" or "The Distributor." In astrology, this planet "divides" the years of life and acts as a primary time-lord.]], that is, the "divider." Look at what remains from his "term" in degrees and minutes until he completes it, and place...

[[page number: 129]]

-> ### BOOK TWO. <-

...and place it in ascensions [[notes: 'Ascensions' refers to the degrees of the celestial equator that rise with a sign; this was a complex mathematical way to measure time where degrees equal years]], and convert the equal degrees of the "term" [[notes: A 'term' is a specific sub-division of a zodiac sign ruled by a particular planet]] into degrees of ascensions. You shall set each degree as one year, occurring within the division of that same planet. After this, look to the lord of the second term and see how many degrees it holds; you shall also set those as ascensions as described above, because one year will be assigned to each degree within the division of that same planet. If that planet is a "Fortune" [[notes: A 'fortune' or 'benefic' is a lucky planet, usually Jupiter or Venus]], it will distribute its influence through the rays of the fortunes, and these years will be passed in tranquility, peace, and prosperity. But if it is a "Malefic" [[notes: A 'malefic' is an unlucky planet, usually Saturn or Mars]], say the opposite. If there is a mix of fortunes and malefics, the person's state will be middling. Do the same for the third, fourth, and fifth terms until the end of their life, if God wills it. And know that a planet signifying the loss of a limb or the hardships of life will bring about its movement and bodily danger when it acts as the "distributor" [[notes: The planet currently ruling a period of life]], by the will of God. Likewise for a planet that signifies a king—that is, honor, and so on.

**I**ikewise, the direction of the degree of the *hylech* [[notes: The *hylech* is the 'Giver of Life,' the specific point in a birth chart used to calculate a person's lifespan]] is used to know the matters of life by God’s will. For you shall direct from the degree of the *hylech* toward the bodies of the fortunes and malefics and their "rays" [[notes: Aspects or angles cast by the planets]], and for every degree found between the *hylech* and the rays or bodies of the malefics, assign one year by the degree of ascensions. Here is an example: The Sun was the *hylech*, and it was in the "Midheaven" [[notes: The highest point of the chart, representing career and public life]] in the fifteenth degree of Capricorn, and the rays of Saturn's "quartile" aspect [[notes: A harsh 90-degree angle]] were at the twelfth degree. We calculated the ascending degrees of the Sun, and they were fourteen degrees. We also calculated the ascensions of Saturn's degrees, and they were twenty degrees and nineteen minutes. After this, we subtracted the degrees of the Sun from the rays of Saturn, and there remained seven degrees and thirty minutes by ascension. We say then that the Sun reaches the quartile aspect of Saturn in four and a half years plus a tenth of a year; at that time, the person born will suffer in the feet from cold and dryness, and experience pain in the knees and gout [[notes: The Latin *podagra* specifically refers to gout in the feet]]. If the span of life for the newborn lasts longer, he shall pass through that term by God’s will. If a "Fortune" planet should cast its rays toward that same term, do all your work similarly, by God’s will. Furthermore, you shall always direct the degree of the Ascendant by ascensions toward the rays of the malefics and fortunes—whether the *hylech* is the Ascendant or not—to know the state of the person born, if God wills it.

**S**imilarly, there are three modes of direction that you must know so that your judgments may be accurate, whether they concern good or evil. The first is the "distributor," which is called the *Algerbuthar* [[notes: A Latinized version of an Arabic astrological term referring to the planet that rules a specific period of life]], which is the lord of the term of the Ascendant. Whether it "beholds" [[notes: Forms an aspect with]] the Ascendant or not, it shall be the distributor, and it will not cease to govern until it completes the degrees of its term within that sign. After this comes the distributor of the second term, which succeeds it, and it will not cease being the distributor until its degrees are finished by ascensions—one year for each degree. You shall do the same until the end of the person's life, if God wills it.

**T**he knowledge of the three rays [[notes: Likely referring to the three specific roles planets play in timing events: Distributor, Lord of Rays, and Receptor]]. The second mode is the "Lord of the Rays," which is known from the first of the planets following the degree of the distributor. Whether that planet is faster in its course than the distributor or slower, it is necessary for the distributor to pass through its rays and be joined to them. When it reaches its rays, if it is a "Fortune," it signifies the lengthening of life, acquisitions, and profit in the matters of that planet and in those things pertaining to its "houses" in the circle [[notes: The 'houses' are the twelve segments of the sky representing different areas of life, like wealth or family]], along with health of the body and a balance of one’s "complexion" [[notes: The balance of the four humors—blood, phlegm, yellow bile, and black bile]]. But if it is a "Malefic," it signifies trouble, weakness, and disease originating from the nature of that planet and the houses it rules. That is, if it is the lord of the house of wealth, he will suffer in his possessions. If it is the lord of the house of children, his child will die. If it is the house of kingship, the king will hinder him. Know this for all the houses.

**T**he third is the "Receptor"—that is, the one who receives the distributor—and also the change from planet to planet. When the distributor is a malefic, and the one who receives the governance from it at the end of its rule is also a malefic, it signifies evil, because it changes from one evil to another. If the distributor has moved through the rays of a malefic and is changed toward the rays of another even after completing the first malefic's rays, and if the person's life has not yet reached its natural end, it may perhaps kill him in this way. For the ancients judged that a man would die if all four factors were malefics. If, however, all four are fortunes, it signifies a lengthening of life and endurance beyond measure, and great wealth, if God wills it. If there are three malefics and one fortune, there will be more evil. If there are three fortunes and one malefic, there will be more good. And if they are equal...

[[vocabulary: hylech (Giver of Life), Saturnus (Saturn), Sol (Sun), Capricornus (Capricorn), Algerbuthar (Period Distributor), diuisor (Distributor), aspectus (Aspect/Angle), directiones (Directions/Timing), ascensiones (Ascensions), nutu dei (by God's will)]]

...if there were fortunes [[notes: "Fortunes" or benefics refer to helpful planets like Jupiter and Venus]], and the harmful ones were good, and the good and bad were equal. Know that here and now we make mention of the explanation of these four factors. The first is that whose division was before the second divisor, and this happens in the middle of the signs—that is, within the sign—but it will be at the beginning of the disposition [[notes: "Disposition" refers to how a planet "manages" or influences a specific part of the zodiac]]. Because the first divisor from the degrees of the ascendant [[notes: The "Ascendant" is the sign rising on the eastern horizon at the moment of birth]] is the **lord of the term** [[notes: In traditional astrology, each zodiac sign is divided into five unequal "terms," each ruled by a specific planet]]. Therefore, the first is not first because it is the same. In the middle of the signs, however, will be the disposition of the divisor, second after the first divisor, and he is the one who "knocked"—that is, who committed the disposition to him. The second is he who receives the disposition from the divisor. The third is the **lord of rays** [[notes: A planet that "casts rays" or aspects toward a specific point]], and he who committed the disposition to the divisor. Furthermore, the four in which there is trust are these: the **divisor**, the **lord of the year**, the **lord of rays**, and the **receiver** who receives from the divisor; and the **sign of profection** [[notes: "Profection" is a timing technique where the Ascendant is moved forward by one sign for every year of life]] is mingled with these. If it is not in the signs where the bodies of the malefics [[notes: "Malefics" are traditionally "harmful" planets, usually Saturn and Mars]] were, or their fourth aspects [[notes: Squares]], or their oppositions, it increases evil and hastens betrayal and death. And if it was at the root [[notes: The "root" or *radix* is the original birth chart]] in the signs where the bodies of the fortunes were, or their rays, and the malefics did not behold it, the year will be healthy and profitable by the will of God. And in the arrangement of days, many shudder to place the disposition in the sign, and they place it in the planets during the **revolution of the year of the nativity** [[notes: Now called a "Solar Return," a chart cast for the moment the Sun returns to its birth position each year]], and of questions and beginnings. And to know the state of the parents, you shall place the first divisor and the disposition of the lord of the term, just as we told you regarding the perfection of the nativity, if God wills. For there are also two directions from the revolution of the year: one to know the minor daily matters until the completion of the year, and another for the greater matters. And there may be one or two or more matters, and this is known from the sign of profection; and I shall explain these modes to you, if God wills.

# **I**N the direction of the ascendant to know the state, you shall always direct from the degree of the ascendant toward the rays of the malefics and the fortunes until the completion of 360 degrees, until it returns to the degree of the ascendant at every 59 minutes and 8 seconds [[notes: This specific value represents the mean daily motion of the Sun, used here as a timing key]] from the second day by equal degrees. When it reaches the fortunes and the planets that are givers and receivers from the malefics, we say that the person will find substance and acquire wealth, and will be healthy in that same disposition; and there will be progress and the acquisition of substance from the substance of the planet and the substance of the sign—that is, the house in which it is—pertaining to the planet from the circle when it has disposed it, if God wills. And the planet which was projecting its rays to the degree and minute of the ascendant will be the disposition at the beginning of the matter. If it did not project its rays to the degree of the ascendant, we will attribute the disposition to the degree of the ascendant until it is applied to a planet or the rays of a planet; and we say that the judgment in this will be in the lord of the ascendant, whether it beholds the ascendant or does not behold it, and whether it is present or absent. After this, you shall give the disposition of the **lord of rays**, to whom the disposition was applied, as we told you before. **Messahallah** [[notes: Masha'allah ibn Athari (c. 740–815 AD), a famous Persian Jewish astrologer and astronomer who served the Abbasid caliphs]] when he directed to know the state of the native from the ascendant, did so from the very degree to which the lord of the ascendant projects its rays, and he gave the disposition of that state to the lord of the ascendant, as is said of the year of **Othman son of Affan** [[notes: Uthman ibn Affan (r. 644–656 AD), the third Caliph of the Islamic Caliphate]], who was the emperor of the Saracens, from the rays of the moon from the midheaven [[notes: The highest point in the chart, representing career and public life]] below the midheaven. What we have already said—because the work of these years in the revolution of the world's year is for the diversity of the common people—it is necessary that there be a direction of the ascendant, and for the master of the nativity from the midheaven. And it is possible that the lord of the ascendant does not behold the ascendant, nor the lord of the midheaven behold the midheaven. But if he said that it shall be directed from the degree of the lord of the ascendant in the ascendant through the degrees of its rays in the ascendant; and if it should be lacking from the **lord of the triplicity** [[notes: Each of the four elements—Fire, Earth, Air, Water—is ruled by a set of three planets known as the "triplicity lords"]] and its degrees in the ascendant, we say that it will be possible that these four do not behold the ascendant. And it is absolutely necessary to direct from the ascendant, and through this their opinion is touched upon—that is, the explanation of those things we told you at the beginning of the work: because he who makes a direction, it is necessary for him to direct from the degree of the ascendant. In the year of the profection, however, the year of the native will arrive according to the number which gives 30 degrees to each year to the sign of profection at a similar degree, and neither of the ascendant. When, therefore, we wish to know the greater states, we shall take from those degrees until the completion of 30 from the second sign by equal degrees—that is, we shall take up to that very degree through which the rays of the fortunes or malefics project, and we shall multiply them by 12 and 6 [[notes: Technical multipliers for timing specific days within a year]]. When 30 degrees are multiplied in this way, they become 365, which are the days of the year. You shall then place the disposition through the rays of that planet; if the planet is a fortune, those days will be...

**W**HEN, by God’s wise command, you have arranged the timing of the newborn in matters of nourishment and life, and have established the direction of the rising degree on the part of the divisor, and the conversion of the degrees of the divisor’s bound into ascensions, and their direction toward the rays of the malefics [[notes: planetary aspects from "unlucky" planets]], and the benefics to each individual degree of the year—and if you wish to know, by God's nod, his accidents and honors—begin, and know of what kind and dignity the newborn may be. The knowledge of this is that you should look, by God's nod, at the sayings of Ptolemy [[notes: Claudius Ptolemy, the 2nd-century foundational figure of Western astrology and astronomy]] concerning the *dostoria* [[margin: Dostoria.]] [[notes: A corruption of the Greek *doryphoria*, meaning "spear-bearing." This refers to a configuration where certain planets act as "bodyguards" to the Sun or Moon, signifying high status.]] of the divine planets from the Sun, and the *dostoria* of the nocturnal planets from the Moon. The explanation of *dostoria* is "security" or "auspiciousness." This occurs when the planets are oriental [[notes: rising before the Sun]] to the Sun by day, and occidental [[notes: setting after the Moon]] to the Moon by night. When, therefore, the superior planets [[notes: Mars, Jupiter, and Saturn]] are oriental to the Sun in their own houses or exaltations, and the Sun is in its own house or exaltation, and the location is an "angle" [[notes: The 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses of a chart, representing the strongest points of influence]], and they aspect one another, the newborn will be a king or a prince similar to a king. And if they are in their houses or exaltations, but not all (or only some) are in angles, the newborn will be a duke or a great prince, if God wills. If they are "falling" [[notes: cadent, or in weak houses]] and "peregrine" [[notes: having no essential dignity or "home" in that part of the zodiac]], the newborn will be from a middle-class family, of good restraint, and honorable among his peers. If, however, the Luminary [[notes: the Sun or Moon]] has no *dostoria* from the superior planets which were in their *hayz* [[notes: an Arabic astrological term referring to a planet being in a favorable "sect" or condition]], the newborn will be of base birth, of no memory, and unknown in his rank. According to Dorotheus [[notes: Dorotheus of Sidon, a 1st-century astrological poet]], one should look in day-births at the lord of the Sun's triplicity—that is, the sign in which the Sun is first during the day—and at the lord of the Moon's triplicity first at night. Afterward, you shall look at the state of the planet in the twelve places, and you shall take the degrees that are between the degree of the planet and the degree of the angle; if the planet is in the first 15 degrees, the newborn will be a prince or like a king. If it is in the next 15 degrees, he will be a noble prince of high memory. If, however, it is in the third 15 degrees, the newborn will be from the middle class; and if it exceeds this, he will be laborious, wretched, and base.

**T**he third method in the knowledge of this matter arises from the estimation of reasonable men from the "Book of Allegories." For "The Philosopher" [[notes: Likely referring to Aristotle or a generic "wise master" common in medieval texts]] said that there are four types of births. Some are born who will be kings, and they persevere in their kingdom; some are born who will be laborers, and they persevere in labor and hardship; and some of those born were first poor and laborious, but after this they are made kings or wealthy, and afterward they are made laborious again. Others, truly, were first kings or wealthy, and afterward they are made laborious and poor. Those who are born kings and remain in their kingdom are those in whose nativity the Lord of the Ascendant and the Moon are in angles, and many [planets] are joined to both in the angles or to the lords of the angles; or the Luminaries and the lords of the angles are joined to the Lord of the Ascendant, and he himself is received in the angles—this signifies that the one to be born will be a king or wealthy, and will persevere in his kingdom and riches. But if the Moon and the Lord of the Ascendant were falling [[notes: in cadent houses]], and were joined to falling planets, and they themselves were the lords of the places called falling, or the lords of the falling places are joined to him, the newborn will be wretched and laborious, the son of outcasts, and he will persevere in his labor. And if the Lord of the Ascendant, the Moon, the Sun, and the lords of the angles are in angles, but are joined to falling and receding planets, and to malefic planets—and the "heads of evil" were the lords of the falling houses—the newborn will be a king of great power, but he will fall from his fortune, his kingdom will be taken away, and he will come to labor and poverty, and some of them are captured and subjected to slavery. If, however, the Lord of the Ascendant, the Moon, and the Sun are falling, or in their "descensions" [[notes: "falls," the zodiac signs where a planet's power is most weakened]], and they are joined to benefics in the angles or to malefics who receive them in the angles, and they themselves were the lords of the angles, they will be born in the houses of laborers and of those who were in the distress and affliction of life, but they will first be princes, and after this they are exalted and honor-

...and they shall be honorable according to what we have told you. Dorotheus [[notes: Dorotheus of Sidon, a 1st-century astrologer whose work influenced both Hellenistic and Arabic traditions.]] also and Hermes [[notes: Referring to Hermes Trismegistus, the legendary father of astrology and hermeticism.]] thought that one should look after the birth of the child at the first planet that proceeds to the degree of the moon, or the degree of the ascendant beyond the degrees of the moon, because that planet signifies the dignity of the child and his fortune. If it is a benefic [[notes: A "fortuna" or benefic is a "good" planet like Jupiter or Venus.]] and the place is suitable for it, he will be a well-fortuned king or rich, by God's will. If it is a malefic [[notes: A "malus" or malefic is a "difficult" planet like Saturn or Mars.]] and hindered in those same places—which are the place of the degree of the moon and the degree of the ascendant—the child will be low-born and hardworking, if God wills.

# P
Hermes thought that the planet which first changes its figure in the revolution of the year of the world [[notes: The "Year of the World" refers to the solar ingress into Aries, used for annual predictions.]] by its movement—namely, from one sign into another, or from the eastern degree to the west, or by its arrival at the degree of the moon or the degree of the ascending sign beyond the moon—that planet will be the Lord of the Year and the significator of the year’s affairs. And all agreed that when the moon proceeds from its middle course to its greater course [[notes: This refers to the speed of the moon’s motion; a "fast" moon was considered a sign of vigor and success.]], the child will be noble and rich. And when it proceeds from its greater course to its middle course, the child’s state will be mediocre among the noble. And when it changes from the middle course to the lesser course, they said the child would be unfortunate and of an evil state. But if the moon is joined to no planet, nor separated from any in the birth chart [[notes: This is known in modern astrology as "Void of Course," signifying a lack of direction or influence.]], the child will be a wild follower of the wasteland, especially if it is in the nature of the malefics; in a bad place, it will increase the evil.

# S
Regarding the knowledge of the state of life in nativities, this is done in many ways according to the sayings of the ancients. Look to the lords of the triplicity [[notes: The "Triplicity" divides the zodiac into four elements (Fire, Earth, Air, Water), each ruled by a set of three planets.]], which holds the authority or power. For you look to the first age of life from the first lord of the triplicity of the Sun, and to the second age from the second lord of the triplicity of the Sun, and to the third age from the third lord of the triplicity of the Sun during the day. Whichever of them is in a mediocre place or a healthier one, that age will be better and more dignified. Similarly, look at night to the lords of the triplicity of the moon, just as you look to the Sun. 

A second way of determining the state of life is according to Ptolemy [[notes: Claudius Ptolemy, the 2nd-century author of the *Tetrabiblos*, the foundational text of Western astrology.]] and all the others: you look to the first half of the first life from the ascendant and its beginning in the twelfth house, but the end of the first life from the second house. And look to the middle of the middle life from the Midheaven (*Medium Coeli*). From the beginning of the middle life from the ninth house, but the boundaries of the same middle life from the eleventh. And the half of the end of life from the seventh house, but the beginning of the final life from the sixth. And the end of that same final life from the eighth house; also look to the half of the state of death from the angle of the earth [[notes: The *Imum Coeli* or the 4th House.]], and the beginning of the state of death from the third house, but the end of the state of death from the fifth. Whichever of these houses contain the benefics, announce good things for them. If they are hindered, it indicates hindrance and evil, and everything horrible; and look for help through the lords of these places and the *Almutaz* [[notes: Also known as the *Almuten*, this is the planet that holds the most "dignity" or power over a specific point in the chart.]] over the accidents of these places, if God wills.

# T
The third way of being is that you should look in nativities at how many planets are joined to the moon in the sign in which it is, for these signify riches, according to the state, number, and quantity of those same planets. But if the moon is joined to no planet, the state of life will be determined from the part of the moon in two ways. First, from the sign of the moon and its place; speak then according to the quantity of its weakness or its strength in the place of the moon. Second, from the lord of the moon and its place, and its strength and weakness, and its conjunction with planets (or the planets' conjunction with it); and speak according to what you see of good or evil. I have already explained to you the timing of nutrition [[notes: Referring to the "Hyleg" or the planet that signifies the life-force and physical health of the infant.]] from the ascendant and its lord, and from the lords of the triplicities of the ascendant and the moon and its lord; and now I shall explain what the twelve houses signify, if God wills.

# C
When you wish to look into the matter of substance [[notes: In astrology, "substance" refers to wealth, possessions, and movable property.]], look at the second house from the ascendant, and whatever planets are in it, and the lord of the second, and the Part of Substance, and the lord of that Part, and also Jupiter, and the Part of Fortune and its lord. Then look at the *Almutaz* over these places, whether there be one or two—and I have already told you that the *Almutaz* who is more dignified and authentic than the others is the one who has the most dignities (that is, who has the most parts in those places by house, exaltation, etc.). After this, look at the health of that same *Almutaz* and its mixture and affinity with the lord of the ascendant through the fourteen modes which signify effect, knowledge, and destruction; and speak according to what you see whether there will be substance for him or not. And when you see there is substance, know from the state of the *Almutaz* at what time of life he will acquire that substance. For if it is oriental [[notes: A planet is "oriental" when it rises before the sun, which was traditionally thought to signify events happening early in life.]], he will have it in his youth; but if it is...

If the planet is occidental [[notes: "Occidental" refers to a planet that sets after the Sun; in this context, it suggests events occurring later in life]], he will gain wealth in old age. # **W**hen you wish to look into the matter of brothers [[notes: In Latin, *fratres* (brothers) often refers generally to siblings of both genders]], look to the third [house] and its ruler, and whatever planets are in the third. If there is no harmony or peace, it signifies hatred and enmities. After this, [determine] whether the native or the brothers are of greater dignity based on the strength of the *Almutaz* of the Ascendant versus the *Almutaz* of the house of brothers, for the stronger of them shall lead. Then look at the lords of the triplicity of Mars—the first, second, and third—and see which of them is strongest or average, for this signifies the brothers' condition. For the first signifies the elder ones, the second the middle ones, and the third the younger ones, by the will of God. If there were planets in it, brothers and sisters will be born after him according to the number of stars you find. If you find any planet in "double" signs, this doubles their number. Likewise, the separation of the Moon from planets signifies those born before him, and the conjunction of the Moon signifies those born after him. If in the seventh [house], it signifies he is the seventh, fourth, or first. If in the fourth [house], it signifies he is the first or fourth. All places signify similarly according to the quantity of the place.

Afterward, you will "direct" [[notes: "Direction" is a predictive technique where points are moved through the zodiac to time future events]] the life of the father from the "Lot of the Father," the Sun, and the degree of the house of fathers—specifically from whichever is most worthy to be the *Hylech* [[notes: The planet that acts as the "giver of life" and determines the lifespan]]—to the places of the fortunate and the malefics. For you shall direct the state of the fathers for every year of "profection" [[notes: A system where the chart is advanced by one sign per year of life]] from the Lot of the Fathers to the places of the fortunes and the malefics. [dig]nity of the Lord of the Year, you shall speak of the safety of the father, and indeed of his loftiness, and to which rank he shall come, from the *dostoria* [[notes: A Latinization of the Greek *doryphoria*, meaning "spear-bearing" or "attendant" planets that flank the Sun or Moon]] of the Sun by the diurnal planets. You shall speak of the gravity of the father’s death from the impediment of the *Almutaz* [[notes: Also known as the *Almuten*, this is the planet that holds the most power or "dignity" over a specific house or point in the chart]] over the affairs of the fathers. If this planet is hindered at the time of death, by day or night, by Saturn through a fourth aspect [[notes: A square aspect, or 90 degrees, usually considered stressful]] or opposition, or even an aspect of the "fortunes" [[notes: Beneficial planets like Jupiter or Venus]] but without "reception" [[notes: A condition where planets "welcome" each other into their respective signs]], this signifies the gravity of his death. And if a malefic [[notes: A harmful planet like Mars or Saturn]] is the hindering lord of the Ascendant, or the *Almutaz* over the Ascendant, perhaps the newborn will kill his own father. You shall also speak of the concord between the father and the child from the harmony of the *Almutaz* over the House of the Fathers and the *Almutaz* over the Ascendant, and likewise of their discord. For if they are in discord, it signifies hatred and enmities; and you shall say that the child is not legitimate, and that the father suspects this, if the Sun is hindered by day by Mars in a fourth aspect or opposition, and at night by Saturn. And you shall say that the mother holds the son in hatred, and does not believe he is her own, when the Moon is hindered by day by Mars, and at night by Saturn. However, some of the wise have said that when the lord of the House of the Fathers does not "behold" [[notes: Does not form a geometric aspect with]] the House of Children, nor the Sun the lord of its own house, nor the lord of the Part of the Father [[notes: A calculated mathematical point in a chart representing the father]], the child will not be the son of that father. If indeed one of them beholds it, he shall be legitimate.

**W**hen you wish to look into the matter of the mother by the will of God, look to the tenth sign [[notes: The Midheaven or 10th House, often associated with the mother in ancient astrology]] and its lord, and the Part of the Mother according to its lord and Venus, as well as the planet *Almutaz* over these places, because he himself will be the significator [[notes: The planet representing a specific person or topic]] of the mother. After this, look at what he signifies in terms of years, and who increases or diminishes them for her, according to what I have shown you regarding years. Then look at the mother’s being and the level of her dignity from the *dostoria* of three planets from the Moon, and from the *dostoria* of Venus from the Moon by night, and by day, by God’s will. And look to the Part of the Mother and the Moon—specifically from those which were the *hylech* [[notes: The "giver of life," a point used to calculate lifespan]] of the mother—at the life of the mother. And you shall direct the *hylech* to the places of the "fortunes" and "malefics," and wherever it reaches a malefic, there shall be danger. If indeed the Moon and the Part of the Mother are in the place of the *hylech*, and you wish to know the place you should direct for the mother, direct from the "frost" [[notes: Likely *gelu*, possibly a mistranslation or technical term for a specific lunar degree]] of the Moon; as often as it reaches the malefics, it will signify danger or the death of the mother, if God wills it.

[[margin: *]]
**A**fter these things, look at her concord and love toward the son, or her hatred, from the *Almutaz* over the Ascendant and over the places I have predicted for mothers: if both significators are in harmony and love each other—that is, if the *Almutaz* of the mother and the *Almutaz* of the child agree—speak according to what you see. Similarly, look for this in the concord and love of the mother toward the father, and speak according to the measure of the agreement of both significators (which are the *Almutaz* of the mother and the *Almutaz* of the father). Speak also on the speed of their deaths and the speed of the entry of either *Almutaz* "under the earth" [[notes: Passing below the horizon/descendant]], according to what Dorotheus [[notes: Dorotheus of Sidon, a 1st-century Hellenistic astrologer]] said. After this, look for knowledge of the father's state from the lords of the triplicity of the Moon by night and day, because the first signifies the beginning of his affairs, the second the middle, and the third the end, if God wills it. Then he speaks of the gravity or lightness of the mother’s death from the hindrance of the Moon and its lord, and the Part of the Mother and its lord: because if they are hindered by malefics, it signifies a bad death. And speak on the speed of the parents' deaths—that is, which of them will die first—based on the speed of the entry of any of their significators under the earth.

**I**t is necessary for you to look into marriage after you have finished looking into children. Therefore, when you wish to look into the marriage of the newborn, look at the seventh [house] and its lord; and look at what planets are in the seventh; also the Moon and Venus, and the Part of Marriage and its lord. By the will of God, you shall look at the *Almutaz* over these places, whether it be one or two. After this, you shall look at the fourteen complexions [[notes: Likely referring to combinations of planetary aspects]] and the concord that exists between him—that is, the *Almutaz* of marriage—and the *Almutaz* over the Ascendant; if there is any complexion of concord between them, the newborn shall marry by the will of God. If, however, it is a sign of many children, or there is a "mixture"—that is, the aspect of significators from signs of many children—you shall say the newborn will have several wives by the will of God, and if it is otherwise, then the contrary. Ptolemy [[notes: Claudius Ptolemy, the famous 2nd-century astronomer and astrologer]] also said: look at the Moon, if it is between the Midheaven...

And all who are thus, we have seen their lives shortened, and they are nourished by a multitude of moisture in men, and a multitude of dryness in women, by the will of God.

### **W**hen you wish to look into the matter of children, whether children will be granted to you or not, and whether his children be many or few: behold the fifth sign and its house, also Venus and Jupiter and their Part of Children, and its lords; and behold the *Almutaz* over these places, whether it be one or two. Then behold whether there be between it and the *Almutaz* over the Ascendant, or the *Almutaz* over the moon, any joining by the four modes, or any agreement (that is, concord); because if it be so, the native will have a son and a helper with him through the 12th [house] and its lord. After this, behold the sign of children and the sign of the *Almutaz* over the native's affairs and the Ascendant; if these signs are of many children, the native will abound in children, if God wills. If indeed between the *Almutaz* over the house of children and the *Almutaz* over the Ascendant there is no connection, and Jupiter is combust [[notes: So close to the Sun that it is "burned up" and its positive influence destroyed]], and Venus is hindered, the native will be sterile, lacking children. Similarly also if the Ascendant is a moveable sign [[notes: Aries, Cancer, Libra, or Capricorn]], and the greatest part of the significators of children are in sterile signs, the native will be sterile without a child all his life, if God wills. If the **Almuten** [[notes: The *Almuten* (or Almutaz) is the planet that holds the most "essential dignity" or power over a specific point in a zodiac chart.]], or **Jupiter**, or the house of the lord of the Almuten is over the "house of children" [[notes: Traditionally the 5th House in astrology]] in the East, a child will be given to the **native** [[notes: The "native" is the person for whom the birth chart was cast]] in his youth. If it is not in the East, the child will be born to him in his old age. He [the author] says similarly regarding the lords of the **triplicity** [[notes: A group of three zodiac signs belonging to the same element (Fire, Earth, Air, or Water)]] of Jupiter—the first, second, and third—for the native. Speak also regarding a multitude of children: if Jupiter or **Venus** regards [[notes: "Regards" or "Aspects" refers to the specific angles planets make with one another, believed to transmit their influence]] the Almuten, or if the Almuten is derived from Jupiter and Venus; whereas a scarcity of children is signified by **Saturn** and **Mars**, and a moderate number by the **Sun** and **Moon**. **Mercury**, however, when with those signifying scarcity, will signify scarcity; and when with those signifying a multitude, they signify a multitude for the native. 

And **Ptolemy** [[notes: Claudius Ptolemy (c. 100–170 AD), the most influential astronomer and astrologer of antiquity]] thought that one looks for children from the 11th house and its lord, and the planets within it; and looks to the father from the **Midheaven** [[notes: The highest point in the chart, the 10th house]] during the day, and at night from the **Angle of the Earth** [[notes: The lowest point in the chart, the 4th house]]. He also looks to the fathers during the day from the Sun and Saturn from the Midheaven. At night, from Saturn and Jupiter and the Angle of the Earth; and look to the planets which are the Almuten over the house of children, whether there be one or two. If any of them or many are driven by the lord of the **Ascendant** [[notes: The zodiac sign rising on the eastern horizon at the moment of birth]], and the Almuten over the Ascendant, they will be good and just children, loving their father. If, however, it is the contrary of what we have said, they will be an impediment to him. If the "significator of children" is evil and impeding the Ascendant and its lord, the son will inflict various hindrances upon the father. And if it impedes the Moon, it will inflict various things upon the mother. If, however, the significators of children are "safe" [[notes: Unharmed by "malefic" planets like Mars or Saturn]], the children will be saved and will not perish. But if the significators of children are impeded, the children will rarely be in concord, if God wills it.

### **I**tem: a new chapter on infirmities and diseases, and inseparable accidents.

Look here to the **sixth house** and its lord, and the planets therein, and to Mercury. Also to the "Part of Infirmities" and inseparable accidents and its lord, the Almuten over these places. For if the Almuten over these places is evil, and is joined to the lord of the Ascendant, or if the Ascendant is impeded by them in the **angles** [[notes: The 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th houses, considered the most powerful "corners" of a chart]], the native will be infirm with many illnesses. If, however, Saturn is the "infirm" one over these places, his illnesses will be from cold and "frugi" [[notes: Likely referring to "frugum" or wasting/consumption]], and they will be long-lasting, such as **epilepsy**, and he may suffer from **dropsy** [[notes: Edema or swelling caused by fluid]] and **gout**. 

And if Mars overcomes in these places, and is in the angles, and regards the lord of the Ascendant and impedes him, it signifies that his illnesses will be from "tubular closure" [[notes: Possibly a blockage of the vessels or "tubes" of the body]] and the flux of blood. If, however, a **Fortune** [[notes: A "benefic" or lucky planet, usually Jupiter or Venus]] overcomes in these places, and the Fortune regards the Almuten over the Ascendant, it will signify the prosperity of the native and his health, as well as salvation in illnesses and the aforementioned accidents; his illnesses will be few, and he will be fortunate in animals, servants, and household slaves (if he has them), as it is said, if the Almuten is over the predicted fortune or is known to the lord of the Ascendant. 

When the "Part" and the **Azamena** [[notes: From the Arabic *al-zamāna*, meaning a permanent physical disability or "inseparable accident"]]—that is, the inseparable accident—is with the Moon in the ninth house, or Mars in the eighth, and it is in the signs of "severed members" at the birth of the native, some limb of his will be cut off by iron. Similarly, if the Part is with the Moon in any "quarter," and the Ascendant is impeded by some evil [planet], accidents will find the native in the limb associated with the sign in which the Moon is located: in the left eye for daytime births, and in the right eye for nighttime births. 

When the **Luminaries** [[notes: The Sun and the Moon]] are in conjunction or prevention [[notes: Syzygy, or the alignment of Sun, Moon, and Earth]], and there are "evils" [malefics] in the fourth aspect of the conjunction or prevention, and an "evil" ascends afterward, the native will lose the right eye from the Sun and the left from the Moon. Likewise, when the luminaries are impeded by the fourth aspect of the malefics, or by their opposition, or if they are with it in one sign, or if they do not ascend while a Fortune does not regard it, the same applies to his eyes. When the Moon is impeded in any sign by malefics, without the projection of rays from the Fortunes to that same term, that limb which belongs to the sign in which the Moon is located will be destroyed. And when the Moon is in the signs that signify impediment to the eyes—such as **Cancer, Leo, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, and Aquarius**—they signify impediments of the eyes. Similarly the Ascendant; when the Moon is in Sagittarius, whether impeded by malefics or not, an impediment happens to him in the eyes, and blindness is feared for him. If, however, it is impeded in **Gemini** and its triplicity by Mars, it signifies rot from **leprosy**, if no Fortune regards him. When the Moon is impeded in **Cancer** and its triplicity by Saturn without the aspect of Fortunes, it signifies "white leprosy" [[notes: Possibly vitiligo or a specific skin condition]], and cancers, and gout, and the diseases called **acila** [[notes: Likely *achila* or *axilla*, referring to glandular swellings or tumors, possibly scrofula]],

**I**n this chapter is the mention of work, kingship, and mastery. Look also to the **Sun**, for if he is in the eastern quarters, the native shall find honor, sublimity, and kingship in his youth, and at the end of his life. For if the first be hindered, he shall be of fragile memory [[notes: "fragilis memoriae" can mean poor reputation, lack of legacy, or literal forgetfulness]] in the beginning of his life. And if the second be hindered, he shall be of fragile memory in the middle of his life. But if the third be hindered, say similarly that at the end of his life he shall be of fragile memory. When **Mars** is in the angles, and especially in the Ascendant, but in the Midheaven by day, the native shall be endangered because of his work, and his body shall be whipped and bound. When **Saturn** is similarly in the angles by night, the native shall be strongly constrained, and shall be conquered and held back, and tormented, if God wills it. **Saturn** in the Ascendant: the native shall be "singular," that is, alone. And if there be brothers or sisters, he shall send them to death before himself, and he shall be constrained, and anguish shall pass through him, and he shall be gluttonous, and especially at night. ...born, and there will be in his work or in his kingdom a mixture, and neither the kingdom nor the leadership shall be directed for him [[notes: meaning his rule or career will be unstable or inconsistent]]. Our example: when the work, kingdom, leadership, and office have been signified for the native, look to the **Almutaz** [[notes: The *Almuten*, the planet that holds the most astrological power or "dignity" over a specific point in the zodiac]] over the **Midheaven** [[notes: *Medium Coeli*, the highest point in the chart, representing career and public reputation]], and the Sun, and the **Part of the Body** [[notes: Likely referring to the Part of Fortune or a similar calculated Arabic Part]]. Similarly, you shall speak from the nature of this Almutaz and those planets aspecting it, whether it be one or many. Look also at the Almutaz and see which of the planets looks upon it, and mix their influence with every work of the Almutaz, and speak according to this. **Ptolemy** [[notes: Claudius Ptolemy, the 2nd-century foundational authority on astronomy and astrology]] also says that the native will then have mastery when a planet is oriental [[notes: rising before the Sun in the morning]], in the Midheaven, for whom the Moon or the Almutaz over the Midheaven was oriental; and if it does not look upon this, then for the whole of those natives there will be no mastery. I say, however, that when the Almutaz over the Midheaven is mixed with the Almutaz for the **Ascendant** [[notes: the eastern horizon at birth, representing the self]], or from Mercury, these will not lack mastery, and it is even better if this planet be oriental from the Sun, or from the Ascendant, or from both. For when they look upon the essence of mastery as a whole, from the quantity of **Mars, Venus, and Mercury** in turn, and in their mixture and aspect, if God wills it. The "quantities" are such as when a planet is in the **fourth aspect** [[notes: a square aspect, 90 degrees]] of another, or in its own **term** [[notes: a specific sub-division of a zodiac sign]] or **sextile aspect** [[notes: 60 degrees]], or with it in one sign. Some of the wise, indeed, wish for the angle of the Midheaven to fall in the eleventh house, and they err when it falls in the ninth. For its fall in the ninth house diminishes the quantity of the dignity of the divider, and its fall in the eleventh increases his honor and his being, by God’s nod. Similarly, all places that are remote, such as the receding and malignant places—like the **sixth, second, eighth, and twelfth**—will be evil [[notes: These houses were traditionally associated with illness, debt, death, and secret enemies]]. For the eleventh and twelfth, the twelfth is evil, and in the Midheaven it is good, if God wills it.

### You should look regarding this twelfth [house] to its lord, and also to Venus and the Part of Friends, and the planets which were in the House of Friends; and look at the Almutaz over these places, whether there be one or two
and the Almutaz over the Ascendant—specifically whether there is between them any of the **fourteen complexions** which I have told you of before, or any agreement. If there should be any of these things between them, the native will have many friends, and it is even better if the sign and its lord are from the signs of many children [[notes: certain zodiac signs were considered "fruitful" or "prolific," signifying abundance]]. After this, look at the Almutaz over the **House of Friends** [[notes: the 11th House]]; if it be **Venus**, or if Venus is joined to the Almutaz over the Ascendant, the greatest part of the native's friends will be from women, and they will be of benefit to him. Similarly, if the eleventh house be the house of the Sun, the planets [[notes: friends]] of the native will be wealthy and noble men, and likewise all planets signify according to their essences. If all the significators, or most of them, be in **mutable signs** [[notes: signs like Gemini or Pisces, associated with changeability]], the friends of the native will not persevere long in his friendship, and they will quickly hold him in hatred. Similarly, if the Almutaz over the Ascendant be evil, and there is no Almutaz over the House of Friends, evil will happen to the friends because of the native. And if it is the other way around, speak to the contrary. If, however, the significators are well-formed, they shall have good, and reverence, and profit from one another, if God wills it. But if the lord of the eleventh does not look upon the eleventh, nor Venus upon the lord of her house, nor the lord of the Part of Friends upon the Part of Friends, the native will be of those who have no mixture with friends, nor will he be sociable, but solitary. And if **fortunes** [[notes: benefic planets like Jupiter or Venus]] be in the House of Friends, his friends will be wealthy and of good restraint. But if **evils** [[notes: malefic planets like Saturn or Mars]] be in it, his friends will be poor and of an evil state. **Ptolemy** says that friendships and enmities happen in three ways: either because of the **concord of spirits** which makes it necessary for a man to love his companion, or because of **profit**, or because **joy or sadness** joins them together. Those who love each other because of the concord of spirits are those in whose nativities the Sun happens to be so—that is, in them, they are in the nativity of one in the same way they were in the nativity of the other, or they are transposed—that is, that the Sun is in that sign in one where the Moon was in the other, and the Moon is in the sign where the Sun was, or the Sun and Moon are in one sign, or in a sextile or **trine aspect** [[notes: 120 degrees, a very harmonious alignment]]. For these people naturally love each other, and especially if the **fortunes** themselves look upon the luminaries [[notes: the Sun and Moon]] in both nativities, and the **evils** do not look upon them. Those whose love is because of joy or sadness are those for whom it happens thus: their sign of the Ascendant is one, or the signs of both nativities look upon each other from a trine or sextile aspect. And it shall happen that the significator of each nativity looks upon the fortunes [[notes: catchword: fortunes]]

# **C**
When the seed has fallen into the womb, in the first month, it is under the disposition of Saturn, who disposes it through cold. And in the second month, Jupiter disposes it and the Lord [[notes: Referring to the Creator.]] casts spirit into it, disposing it with a certain temperament [[notes: A "temperament" in medieval medicine was the specific balance of the four humors/qualities.]]. In the third month, it is disposed by Mars, and it becomes blood. In the fourth month, the Sun disposes it, and God inspires into it the breath of life—that is, it becomes animated—and for that reason, the Sun then grants it a portion in the *hylech* [[notes: The *hylech* is the "giver of life," a specific point in a chart used to calculate the life force and longevity of the child.]]. Do you not see that when the Sun enters a sign, it moves time and brings a likeness of the nature of that sign to the earth? When it has moved from a sign, the work of that same sign recedes; this happens because the body is without a soul [[notes: This implies the Sun provides the animating principle that gives the physical body its vital spark.]]. In the fifth month, it is disposed by Venus, and God composes in it the male or female sex. In the sixth, by Mercury, the tongue is worked upon. In the seventh, the Moon, and its image is perfected. If it should be born then during the disposition of the Moon, it will survive [[notes: Astrologers believed seven-month babies were viable because they had completed the cycle of the seven traditional planets.]]. But if it is born in the eighth month, the disposition returns to Saturn, and it will die. And if it is born in the ninth month, the disposition returns to Jupiter, and it will live, if God wills it.

# **C**
Therefore, when you wish to know the degree of an unknown ascendant [[notes: The "ascendant" is the sign rising on the eastern horizon at the moment of birth. Knowing the exact degree is crucial for accurate horoscopes.]], set the figure of that same ascension and the planets in their places in the signs. After this, know whether it is conjunctional or preventional [[notes: This refers to whether the birth occurred after a New Moon (conjunction) or a Full Moon (prevention/opposition).]], and you shall verify it—that is, the conjunction or prevention—by its degree and minute. If it was conjunctional, look at the planet that rules the degree of the conjunction. If it was preventional, you shall look at the degree of that luminary [[notes: The Sun or the Moon.]] which was above the earth. After this, look for the planet which, above the others, has more dignities [[notes: "Dignities" are a ranking system of a planet's strength based on its position, such as being in its own "house" or "exaltation."]] in the degree of conjunction or prevention, whether by house, exaltation, triplicity, or term; you shall place the aspect in the part of fortitude [[notes: Likely referring to the planet's overall strength or "Fortuna."]]. For example: if a planet is the lord of the house and has aspected the degree of conjunction or prevention, and another is the lord of the exaltation and has aspected it from there, you shall see which is more worthy. You will know the strengths of these from their places. However, if two or more planets agree, you shall look for those closer to the others by "foundation" and establish that one as the author [[notes: The "author" or *almuten* is the most powerful planet in the chart regarding a specific matter.]]. And "closer by foundation" means looking at the planets to see if they are in an angle [[notes: The "angles" (1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th houses) are the most powerful areas of a chart.]] that is closer to the degree of the angle. And if they are oriental [[notes: Rising before the Sun.]], which is closer to the Sun. And if in the "terms" [[notes: Sub-divisions of a sign.]], which is closer to the term. If, however, the dignity of both planets and their aspects are equal, you shall establish as the author the one who is closer in aspect. After this, look at that author to see whether it is closer to the degree of the ascendant or the degree of the Midheaven (*medium coeli*) and its nadir [[notes: The Midheaven is the highest point; the Nadir is the lowest point directly opposite it.]]. If it is closer to the degree of the ascendant and its nadir, cast away the degree of the ascendant—that is, dismiss it—and set the ascendant similar to the degree and minute of the planet. But if it is closer to the degree of the Midheaven and nadir, set the degree of the Midheaven like the degree and minute of the planet. Then, know how many hours ascend, at which hour those degrees will ascend through the work of extracting the ascendant from the Midheaven; and whatever hours result for you, establish the planets upon them, and this will be the time of the hour of birth, if God wills it.

# **S**
To know the ascendant from the Midheaven: look from the first minute of Capricorn unto the minute of the Midheaven through the ascensions of the direct circle [[notes: Refers to Right Ascension on the celestial equator.]]. After this, project this from the first minute of Aries through the ascensions I have explained to you, and whatever results, turn it into equal degrees, and that shall be the ascendant.
